the river.description: The River is a 1984 American Southern Gothic drama film directed by Mark Rydell and written by Robert Dillon and Julian Barry, who based the screenplay on actual stories of East Tennessee farmers who lost their crops due to damage caused by bad weather, and having to reluctantly work industrial jobs as strikebreakers in nearby cities to avoid foreclosure on their farmland.

the man who knew too much 1934.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
the man who knew too much 1934.wikipedia: The Man Who Knew Too Much (1934 film)
the man who knew too much 1934.description: The Man Who Knew Too Much is a 1934 British spy thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock for Gaumont British. Starring Leslie Banks and Peter Lorre, it was one of the most successful and critically acclaimed films of Hitchcock's British period.

waltzes from vienna.title: Waltzes from Vienna
waltzes from vienna.description: Waltzes from Vienna is a 1934 British biographical film directed by Alfred Hitchcock, sometimes known as Strauss' Great Waltz. It was part of the cycle of operetta films made in Britain during the 1930s. Hitchcock's film is based on the stage musical Waltzes from Vienna, which premiered in Vienna in October 1930.

the phantom of the opera.title: The Phantom of the Opera
the phantom of the opera.wikipedia: The Phantom of the Opera (1998 film)
the phantom of the opera.description: The Phantom of the Opera (Italian: Il fantasma dell'opera) is a 1998 English-language Italian romance horror film directed by Dario Argento, adapted from the 1910 novel of the same name by Gaston Leroux. It is not to be confused with the 1987 film Opera (or Terror at the Opera), also directed by Dario Argento.

the night and the moment.title: The Night and the Moment
the night and the moment.description: The Night and the Moment is a 1994 erotic drama film co-written and directed by Anna Maria Tatò and starring Willem Dafoe, Lena Olin and Miranda Richardson. It was screened out of competition at the 51st Venice International Film Festival.

the mystery of oberwald.title: The Mystery of Oberwald
the mystery of oberwald.description: The Mystery of Oberwald (Italian: Il mistero di Oberwald) is a 1980 Italian–German television drama film directed by Michelangelo Antonioni and starring Monica Vitti, Paolo Bonacelli, and Franco Branciaroli.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: Distance is a 2001 film by Japanese director Hirokazu Kore-eda, starring Arata, Tadanobu Asano, Yūsuke Iseya, Susumu Terajima, and Yui Natsukawa.

arabella.title: Arabella
arabella.description: Arabella is a 1967 Italian comedy film in the English language, starring Virna Lisi, Terry-Thomas and James Fox. It was directed by Mauro Bolognini.

number two.title: Number Two
number two.description: Number Two (French: Numéro deux), by Jean-Luc Godard and Anne-Marie Miéville, is a 1975 experimental film about a young family in a social housing complex in France.

black moon.title: Black Moon
black moon.description: Black Moon is a 1975 Franco-German experimental fantasy horror film directed by Louis Malle and starring Cathryn Harrison, Joe Dallesandro, Therese Giehse and Alexandra Stewart. Though produced in France, its dialogue is in both French and English.

todo modo.title: Todo modo
todo modo.description: Todo modo (lit. "By all means"), also known in English as One Way or Another, is a 1976 Italian satirical political drama film directed by Elio Petri starring Gian Maria Volonté and Marcello Mastroianni. It is loosely based on the novel of the same name by Leonardo Sciascia.

la supertestimone.title: La supertestimone
la supertestimone.description: La supertestimone is a 1971 Italian black comedy film, directed by Franco Giraldi. For this film Monica Vitti was awarded with a Globo d'oro for Best Actress. In the film, a pimp is suspected of murdering his lover.

seven psychopaths.title: Seven Psychopaths
seven psychopaths.description: Seven Psychopaths is a 2012 satirical crime comedy-drama film directed, written, and co-produced by Martin McDonagh and starring Colin Farrell, Sam Rockwell, Woody Harrelson, and Christopher Walken, with Tom Waits, Abbie Cornish, Olga Kurylenko, and Željko Ivanek in supporting roles.

dragnet girl.title: Dragnet Girl
dragnet girl.description: Dragnet Girl (非常線の女, Hijōsen no Onna) is a 1933 Japanese silent gangster film directed by Yasujirō Ozu. Written by Tadao Ikeda, the film tells the story of a gangster and his girlfriend finding redemption through the actions of an innocent girl and her not-so-innocent brother.

the pleasure garden 1925.title: The Pleasure Garden
the pleasure garden 1925.description: The Pleasure Garden is a 1926 silent drama film directed by Alfred Hitchcock in his feature film directorial debut. Based on the 1923 novel by Oliver Sandys, The Pleasure Garden is about two chorus girls, played by Virginia Valli and Carmelita Geraghty, at the Pleasure Garden Theatre in London and their troubled relationships.

notre musique.title: Notre musique
notre musique.description: Notre musique (English: Our Music) is a 2004 film directed by Jean-Luc Godard. The film reflects on violence, morality, and the representation of violence in film, and touches especially on past colonialism and the current Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

dracula.title: Dracula
dracula.description: Dracula is a 1979 gothic horror film directed by John Badham. The film stars Frank Langella in the title role as well as Laurence Olivier, Donald Pleasence and Kate Nelligan.

fat man and little boy.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
fat man and little boy.description: Fat Man and Little Boy (released in the United Kingdom as Shadow Makers) is a 1989 American epic historical war drama film directed by Roland Joffé, who co-wrote the script with Bruce Robinson. The story follows the Manhattan Project, the secret Allied endeavor to develop the first nuclear weapons during World War II.

four flies on grey velvet.title: Four Flies on Grey Velvet
four flies on grey velvet.description: Four Flies on Grey Velvet (Italian: 4 mosche di velluto grigio) is a 1971 giallo film co-written and directed by Dario Argento, and starring Michael Brandon, Mimsy Farmer, Jean-Pierre Marielle, Francine Racette and Bud Spencer.

halloween ii.title: Halloween II
halloween ii.description: Halloween II is a 1981 American slasher film directed by Rick Rosenthal, in his directorial debut, written and produced by John Carpenter and Debra Hill, and starring Jamie Lee Curtis and Donald Pleasence, who reprise their respective roles as Laurie Strode and Dr.

rango.title: Rango
rango.description: Rango is a 2011 American animated Western comedy film directed by Gore Verbinski and written by John Logan. The film stars Johnny Depp as its titular protagonist, with Isla Fisher, Abigail Breslin, Alfred Molina, Bill Nighy, Harry Dean Stanton, Ray Winstone and Timothy Olyphant in supporting roles.

the postman always rings twice.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
the postman always rings twice.wikipedia: The Postman Always Rings Twice (1981 film)
the postman always rings twice.description: The Postman Always Rings Twice is a 1981 American neo-noir erotic thriller film directed by Bob Rafelson and written by David Mamet (in his screenwriting debut). Starring Jack Nicholson and Jessica Lange, it is the fourth adaptation of the 1934 novel by James M.

the last run.title: The Last Run
the last run.description: The Last Run is a 1971 American action thriller film directed by Richard Fleischer, written by Alan Sharp, and starring George C. Scott, Tony Musante, and Trish Van Devere. The film follows a former mob getaway driver (Scott) living in Portugal, who is hired to transport a fugitive couple (Musante and Van Devere).

machibuse.title: Machibuse
machibuse.description: Machibuse (Japanese: 待ち伏せ) is a 1970 Japanese drama film directed by Hiroshi Inagaki.

vladimir and rosa.title: Vladimir and Rosa
vladimir and rosa.description: Vladimir and Rosa (Original title: Vladimir et Rosa) is a 1971 French-language drama film from France and West Germany by the Dziga Vertov Group. The film stars Yves Afonso, Juliet Berto, Frankie Dymon, while Godard and Gorin play the titular Vladimir and Rosa, respectively.

jlg jlg self portrait in december.title: JLG/JLG – Self-Portrait in December
jlg jlg self portrait in december.description: JLG/JLG – Self-Portrait in December (French: JLG/JLG - autoportrait de décembre) is a 1995 French documentary film directed by Jean-Luc Godard.

showing up.title: Showing Up
showing up.description: Showing Up is a 2022 American comedy-drama film co-written and directed by Kelly Reichardt. Michelle Williams stars as a sculptor managing the competing attentions of her art, job, family, and friendships.

nadine.title: Nadine
nadine.description: Nadine is a 1987 American crime comedy film written and directed by Robert Benton and starring Jeff Bridges and Kim Basinger.

the rainmaker.title: The Rainmaker
the rainmaker.description: The Rainmaker is a 1997 American legal drama film written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola based on John Grisham's 1995 novel of the same name. It stars Matt Damon, Claire Danes, Jon Voight, Mary Kay Place, Mickey Rourke, Danny DeVito, Danny Glover, Roy Scheider, Virginia Madsen, and Teresa Wright in her final film role.

the sun also rises.title: The Sun Also Rises
the sun also rises.description: The Sun Also Rises (Chinese: 太阳照常升起; pinyin: Tàiyáng zhàocháng shēng-qǐ) is a 2007 Chinese film directed, produced and co-written by Jiang Wen. It stars Joan Chen, Anthony Wong, Jaycee Chan, and Jiang himself.

the house on carroll street.title: The House on Carroll Street
the house on carroll street.description: The House on Carroll Street is a 1988 American neo-noir film directed by Peter Yates, and starring Kelly McGillis, Jeff Daniels, Mandy Patinkin, and Jessica Tandy.

good men good women.title: Good Men, Good Women
good men good women.description: Good Men, Good Women (Chinese: 好男好女) is a 1995 Taiwanese film directed by Hou Hsiao-hsien, starring Annie Yi, Lim Giong, and Jack Kao. It is the last installment in the trilogy that began with A City of Sadness (1989) and continued with The Puppetmaster (1993).

brink of life.title: Brink of Life
brink of life.description: Brink of Life, (Swedish: Nära livet), and known as So Close to Life in the UK, is a 1958 Swedish drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman. At the 1958 Cannes Film Festival, Bergman won the Best Director Award, and Andersson, Dahlbeck, Ornäs and Thulin won the Best Actress Award.

the spirit of st louis.title: The Spirit of St. Louis
the spirit of st louis.description: The Spirit of St. Louis is a 1957 American biographical drama film directed by Billy Wilder and starring James Stewart as Charles Lindbergh. The screenplay was adapted by Charles Lederer, Wendell Mayes and Wilder from Lindbergh's 1953 autobiographical account of his historic flight, which won the Pulitzer Prize in 1954.

for ever mozart.title: For Ever Mozart
for ever mozart.description: For Ever Mozart is a 1996 feature film directed, written and edited by Jean-Luc Godard. The film's title is a bilingual pun intentionally meant to sound like "Faut rêver Mozart" ("Dream Mozart, dream" in French).

new york new york.title: New York, New York
new york new york.description: New York, New York is a 1977 American musical romantic comedy film directed by Martin Scorsese from a screenplay by Earl Mac Rauch and Mardik Martin, based on a story by Rauch. John Kander and Fred Ebb wrote several songs for the film, including "New York, New York", which became a worldwide hit and standard.

l amore.title: L'Amore
l amore.description: L'amore (Love) is a 1948 Italian drama anthology film directed by Roberto Rossellini, starring Anna Magnani and Federico Fellini. It consists of two parts, The Human Voice (Una voce umana), based on Jean Cocteau's 1929 play of the same title, and The Miracle (Il miracolo), based on Ramón del Valle-Inclán's 1904 novel Flor de santidad.

steamboy.title: Steamboy
steamboy.description: Steamboy (Japanese: スチームボーイ, Hepburn: Suchīmubōi) is a 2004 Japanese animated steampunk action film directed and co-written by Katsuhiro Otomo, produced by Sunrise, it is his second major anime as a director, following Akira (1988).

the most gentle confessions.title: The Most Gentle Confessions
the most gentle confessions.description: The Most Gentle Confessions (French: Les aveux les plus doux) is a 1971 crime thriller film directed by Édouard Molinaro and starring Philippe Noiret, Roger Hanin and Caroline Cellier. It was a co-production between France, Italy and Algeria.

the phantom of liberty.title: The Phantom of Liberty
the phantom of liberty.description: The Phantom of Liberty (French: Le Fantôme de la liberté) is a 1974 surrealist satirical dark comedy film co-written and directed by Luis Buñuel and produced by Serge Silberman.

fear of fear.title: Fear of Fear
fear of fear.description: Fear of Fear (German: Angst vor der Angst) is a 1975 West German drama film by Rainer Werner Fassbinder starring Margit Carstensen. Fear of Fear is the fifth film by R. W. Fassbinder for the WDR in cooperation with editor Peter Märthesheimer.

superman.title: Superman
superman.description: Superman (also marketed as Superman: The Movie) is a 1978 superhero film based on the DC Comics character Superman, portrayed by Christopher Reeve. It is the first of four installments in the Superman film series starring Reeve as Superman.

in praise of love.title: In Praise of Love
in praise of love.description: In Praise of Love (French: Éloge de l'amour) is a 2001 French film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard. The black-and-white and color drama was shot by Julien Hirsch and Christophe Pollock." This aphorism is illustrated by In Praise of Love (Éloge de l'amour), which reverses the order of past and present.

the ninth gate.title: The Ninth Gate
the ninth gate.description: The Ninth Gate is a 1999 neo-noir horror thriller film directed, produced, and co-written by Roman Polanski. An international co-production between the United States, Portugal, France, and Spain, the film is loosely based upon Arturo Pérez-Reverte's 1993 novel The Club Dumas.

the assassination of jesse james by the.title: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
the assassination of jesse james by the.wikipedia: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
the assassination of jesse james by the.description: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford is a 2007 American epic revisionist Western film written and directed by Andrew Dominik. Based on Ron Hansen's 1983 novel of the same name, the film dramatizes the relationship between Jesse James and Robert Ford, focusing on the events that led up to the killing.

anzukko.title: Anzukko
anzukko.description: Anzukko (Japanese: 杏っ子), also known as Little Peach, is a 1958 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse. It is based on a novel by Saisei Murō.

the voyeur.title: The Voyeur
the voyeur.description: The Voyeur (Italian: Giuochi particolari) is a 1970 Italian drama film directed by Franco Indovina.

ransom.title: Ransom
ransom.description: Ransom, known in North America and some countries as The Terrorists, is a 1975 British crime film starring Sean Connery and Ian McShane and directed by Finnish director Caspar Wrede.

roma citta libera.title: Roma città libera
roma citta libera.description: Rome, Free City (Italian: Roma città libera) is a 1946 Italian drama film directed by Marcello Pagliero and starring Valentina Cortese, Andrea Checchi, Marisa Merlini and Vittorio De Sica. The film's sets were designed by the art director Gastone Medin.

how is it going.title: How Is It Going?
how is it going.description: How's It Going (Original French title: Comment ça va) is a French film directed by Jean-Luc Godard and Anne-Marie Miéville in 1975, released at the Cannes Film Festival in 1976 and then in French cinemas in 1978.

suburbicon.title: Suburbicon
suburbicon.description: Suburbicon is a 2017 American black comedy crime film directed by George Clooney and co-written by the Coen brothers, Clooney, and Grant Heslov.

joy of learning.title: Joy of Learning
joy of learning.description: Joy of Learning (French: Le Gai savoir) is a 1969 experimental film by Jean-Luc Godard. The shooting started before the events of May 68 and was finished shortly afterwards., the film was upon completion rejected by French national television, then released in the cinema where it was subsequently banned by the French government.

short working day.title: Short Working Day
short working day.description: Short Working Day (Polish: Krótki dzień pracy) is a Polish film directed by Krzysztof Kieślowski. Written by Kieślowski and Hanna Krall, the film is about the workers protests in June '76 in Radom, as seen from the perspective of the local Secretary of the Polish United Workers' Party.

taza son of cochise.title: Taza, Son of Cochise
taza son of cochise.description: Taza, Son of Cochise is a 1954 American Western film directed by Douglas Sirk and starring Rock Hudson and Barbara Rush. The film was shot in 3D, and is one of just two films confirmed to have been released in the Pola-Lite 3D System using one projector.

the missouri breaks.title: The Missouri Breaks
the missouri breaks.description: The Missouri Breaks is a 1976 American Western film starring Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson. The film was directed by Arthur Penn, with supporting performances by Randy Quaid, Harry Dean Stanton, Frederic Forrest, John McLiam, and Kathleen Lloyd in her film debut.

night moves.title: Night Moves
night moves.description: Night Moves is a 2013 American drama thriller film directed by Kelly Reichardt and written by Reichardt and Jonathan Raymond, starring Jesse Eisenberg, Dakota Fanning, Peter Sarsgaard, Alia Shawkat, and James LeGros.

utamaro and his five women.title: Utamaro and His Five Women
utamaro and his five women.description: a. Five Women Around Utamaro (Japanese: 歌麿をめぐる五人の女, Hepburn: Utamaro o meguru gonin no onna) is a 1946 Japanese historical drama film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi. It is based on the novel of the same title by Kanji Kunieda, itself a fictionalized account of the life of famous printmaker Kitagawa Utamaro.

duck you sucker.title: Duck, You Sucker!
duck you sucker.description: Duck, You Sucker! (Italian: Giù la testa, lit. "Duck Your Head", "Get Down"), also known as A Fistful of Dynamite and Once Upon a Time ... the Revolution, is a 1971 epic Zapata Western film directed and co-written by Sergio Leone and starring Rod Steiger, James Coburn, and Romolo Valli.

sabrina.title: Sabrina
sabrina.description: Sabrina is a 1995 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Sydney Pollack from a screenplay by Barbara Benedek and David Rayfiel.

goodbye to language.title: Goodbye to Language
goodbye to language.description: Goodbye to Language (French: Adieu au Langage) is a 2014 French-Swiss narrative essay film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard. It stars Héloïse Godet, Kamel Abdeli, Richard Chevallier, Zoé Bruneau, Jessica Erickson and Christian Grégori and was shot by cinematographer Fabrice Aragno.

the image book.title: The Image Book
the image book.description: The Image Book (French: Le Livre d'image) is a 2018 Swiss avant-garde essay film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard. It was his final feature film before his death in 2022.

one hundred and one nights.title: One Hundred and One Nights
one hundred and one nights.description: One Hundred and One Nights (French: Les cent et une nuits de Simon Cinéma) is a 1995 comedy film written and directed by Agnès Varda. A light-hearted look at 100 years of commercial cinema, it celebrates in vision and sound favourite films from France, Germany, Italy, Japan, and the United States.

lightning.title: Lightning
lightning.description: Lightning (Japanese: 稲妻, Hepburn: Inazuma) is a 1952 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse, and starring Hideko Takamine. It is based on the 1936 novel by Fumiko Hayashi and was the second in a series of adaptations of Hayashi's work by Naruse after the 1951 Repast.

mr mrs smith.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
mr mrs smith.description: Mr. & Mrs. Smith is a 1941 American screwball comedy film directed by Alfred Hitchcock, written by Norman Krasna, and starring Carole Lombard and Robert Montgomery. It also features Gene Raymond, Jack Carson, Philip Merivale, and Lucile Watson.

incident at a corner.title: Incident at a Corner
incident at a corner.description: Incident at a Corner is an episode of the American television anthology series Startime directed by Alfred Hitchcock that aired on April 5, 1960.

black hawk down.title: Black Hawk Down
black hawk down.description: Black Hawk Down is a 2001 American epic war film directed and produced by Ridley Scott, and co-produced by Jerry Bruckheimer, from a screenplay by Ken Nolan. It is based on the 1999 eponymous non-fiction book by journalist Mark Bowden, about the crew of a Black Hawk helicopter that was shot down during the Battle of Mogadishu.

the 50 year argument.title: The 50 Year Argument
the 50 year argument.description: The 50 Year Argument is a documentary film by Martin Scorsese and co-directed by David Tedeschi about the history and influence of the New York Review of Books, which marked its 50th anniversary in 2013.

sea fog.title: Sea Fog
sea fog.description: Sea Fog (Korean: 해무; RR: Haemu) is a 2014 South Korean crime thriller film directed by Shim Sung-bo.

in bruges.title: In Bruges
in bruges.description: In Bruges is a 2008 black comedy-drama crime thriller film directed and written by Martin McDonagh in his feature-length debut. It stars Colin Farrell and Brendan Gleeson as two London-based Irish hitmen hiding in Bruges, with Ralph Fiennes as their boss.

one from the heart.title: One from the Heart
one from the heart.description: One from the Heart is a 1982 American musical romantic drama film co-written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola. Starring Frederic Forrest, Teri Garr, Raúl Juliá, Nastassja Kinski, Lainie Kazan and Harry Dean Stanton.

woman to woman.title: Woman to Woman
woman to woman.description: Woman to Woman is a 1923 British silent drama film directed by Graham Cutts, with Alfred Hitchcock as the uncredited assistant director and co-screenwriter. The film was the first of three adaptions of the 1921 play Woman to Woman by Michael Morton.

the passionate adventure.title: The Passionate Adventure
the passionate adventure.description: The Passionate Adventure is a 1924 British silent drama film directed by Graham Cutts and starring Clive Brook and Alice Joyce. The film was adapted from a novel by Frank Stayton by Alfred Hitchcock and Michael Morton, with Hitchcock also credited as assistant director to Cutts.

the white shadow.title: The White Shadow
the white shadow.description: The White Shadow, also known as White Shadows in the United States, is a 1923 British silent drama film directed by Graham Cutts and starring Betty Compson, Clive Brook, and Henry Victor.

the lodger a story of the london fog.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
the lodger a story of the london fog.wikipedia: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
the lodger a story of the london fog.description: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog is a 1927 British silent thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Marie Ault, Arthur Chesney, June Tripp, Malcolm Keen and Ivor Novello. Hitchcock's third feature film and the earliest to survive intact, it was released on 14 February 1927 in London and on 10 June 1928 in New York City.

easy virtue.title: Easy Virtue
easy virtue.description: Easy Virtue is a 1928 British silent romance film directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Isabel Jeans, Franklin Dyall and Ian Hunter. The movie is loosely based on the 1924 play Easy Virtue by Noël Coward.

champagne.title: Champagne
champagne.description: Champagne is a 1928 British silent comedy film directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Betty Balfour, Gordon Harker and Jean Bradin. The screenplay was based on an original story by writer and critic Walter C.

the farmer s wife.title: The Farmer's Wife
the farmer s wife.description: The Farmer's Wife is a 1928 British silent romantic comedy film directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Jameson Thomas, Lillian Hall-Davis and Gordon Harker. It is adapted from a 1916 play of the same name by British novelist, poet and playwright Eden Phillpotts, best known for a series of novels based on Dartmoor, in Devon.

the stendhal syndrome.title: The Stendhal Syndrome
the stendhal syndrome.description: The Stendhal Syndrome (Ital. La Sindrome di Stendhal) is a 1996 Italian psychological thriller film written and directed by Dario Argento and starring his daughter Asia Argento, with Thomas Kretschmann and Marco Leonardi.

the lady vanishes.title: The Lady Vanishes
the lady vanishes.description: The Lady Vanishes is a 1938 British mystery thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Margaret Lockwood and Michael Redgrave.

let the bullets fly.title: Let the Bullets Fly
let the bullets fly.description: Let the Bullets Fly is a 2010 action comedy film written and directed by Jiang Wen, based on a story by Ma Shitu. The film is a Chinese-Hong Kong co-production, set in Sichuan during the 1920s when the bandit Zhang (Jiang Wen) descends upon a town posing as its new governor.

the island.title: The Island
the island.description: The Island is a 1980 American action adventure-horror film directed by Michael Ritchie and starring Michael Caine and David Warner. The film was based on a 1979 novel of the same name by Peter Benchley who also wrote the screenplay.

angela s ashes.title: Angela's Ashes
angela s ashes.description: Angela's Ashes is a 1999 biographical drama film based on the memoir of the same name by Frank McCourt.

the boys from fengkuei.title: The Boys from Fengkuei
the boys from fengkuei.description: The Boys from Fengkuei (Chinese: 風櫃來的人), also known as All the Youthful Days, is a 1983 Taiwanese film directed by Hou Hsiao-hsien. The movie is about a group of impulsive teenagers with nothing to do and high energy.

i wish.title: I Wish
i wish.description: Miracle) is a 2011 Japanese family drama film, edited, written, and directed by Hirokazu Kore-eda. This film stars real-life brothers Koki Maeda and Oshiro Maeda, along with veteran actress Kirin Kiki and actor Joe Odagiri.

umi yori mo mada fukaku.title: Umi yori mo Mada Fukaku
umi yori mo mada fukaku.description: After the Storm (海よりもまだ深く, Umi yori mo Mada Fukaku; "Even Deeper than the Sea") is a 2016 Japanese family drama film written, directed and edited by Hirokazu Kore-eda. It was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 2016 Cannes Film Festival and was released in Japan on May 21, 2016.

what.title: What?
what.description: What?, and Diary of Forbidden Dreams) is a 1972 comedy film co-written and directed by Roman Polanski and starring Sydne Rome, Marcello Mastroianni, Hugh Griffith and Romolo Valli.

taira clan saga.title: Taira Clan Saga
taira clan saga.description: Shin Heike Monogatari (新・平家物語; lit. "New Tale of the Heike") is a 1955 Japanese film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi. It is based on a prose version by Eiji Yoshikawa of a Japanese epic poem, The Tale of the Heike.

allemagne 90 neuf zero.title: Allemagne 90 neuf zéro
allemagne 90 neuf zero.description: Germany Year 90 Nine Zero (French: Allemagne année 90 neuf zéro) is a French film directed by Jean-Luc Godard and starring Eddie Constantine in his signature role as detective Lemmy Caution. This is the second film in which Godard and Constantine collaborated with the Lemmy Caution character, although it is not a sequel to Alphaville.

i tre corsari.title: I tre corsari
i tre corsari.description: The Three Pirates (Italian: I tre corsari) is a 1952 Italian adventure film directed by Mario Soldati. It is based on a novel by Emilio Salgari.

big deal after 20 years.title: Big Deal After 20 Years
big deal after 20 years.description: Big Deal After 20 Years (Italian: I soliti ignoti vent'anni dopo) is a 1985 Italian comedy film directed by Amanzio Todini. It is the sequel to Big Deal on Madonna Street and Audace colpo dei soliti ignoti.

the truce.title: The Truce
the truce.description: The Truce (Italian: La Tregua) is a 1997 film directed by Francesco Rosi, who co-wrote the screenplay with Stefano Rulli and Sandro Petraglia, and its story treatment with Tonino Guerra based on Primo Levi's memoir, The Truce.

the cotton club.title: The Cotton Club
the cotton club.description: The Cotton Club is a 1984 American musical crime drama film co-written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola and based on James Haskins' 1977 book of the same name. The story centers on the Cotton Club, a 1930s Harlem jazz club.

cinderella liberty.title: Cinderella Liberty
cinderella liberty.description: Cinderella Liberty is a 1973 American drama film adapted by Daryl Ponicsan from his 1973 novel of the same title. The film tells the story of a sailor who falls in love with a prostitute and becomes a surrogate father for her 10-year-old mixed race son.

i ll do anything.title: I'll Do Anything
i ll do anything.description: I'll Do Anything is a 1994 American comedy-drama film written and directed by James L. Brooks. While a large part of the film is a satire of the film industry, it also skewers relationships from various angles.

hope.title: Hope
hope.description: Hope (Polish: Nadzieja; German: Hoffnung) is a 2007 German-Polish drama film directed by Stanisław Mucha. It was entered into the 29th Moscow International Film Festival.

casanova 70.title: Casanova 70
casanova 70.description: Casanova 70 is a 1965 Italian comedy film produced by Carlo Ponti, directed by Mario Monicelli and starring Marcello Mastroianni, Virna Lisi, Enrico Maria Salerno and Michèle Mercier.

village of the damned.title: Village of the Damned
village of the damned.description: Village of the Damned is a 1995 American science fiction horror film directed by John Carpenter, written by David Himmelstein, and starring Christopher Reeve, Kirstie Alley, Linda Kozlowski, and Michael Paré.

vampires.title: Vampires
vampires.description: Vampires (also known as John Carpenter's Vampires) is a 1998 American horror-action film directed and scored by John Carpenter and starring James Woods. It was adapted from the novel Vampires by John Steakley.

dong.title: Dong
dong.description: Dong (simplified Chinese: 东; traditional Chinese: 東; pinyin: dōng; lit. 'East') is a 2006 documentary film by Chinese director, Jia Zhangke.

useless.title: Useless
useless.description: Useless (simplified Chinese: 无用; traditional Chinese: 無用; pinyin: wú yòng) is a 2007 documentary film directed by Jia Zhangke. It is Jia's second full-length documentary film after 2006's Dong. The film follows China's fashion and clothing industry.

many wars ago.title: Many Wars Ago
many wars ago.description: Many Wars Ago (Italian: Uomini contro; lit. 'Men Against') is a 1970 anti-war film set on the Alpine Front of the First World War. Directed, produced, and co-written by Francesco Rosi, the film is based on Emilio Lussu's memoir One Year on the High Plateau, recounting his experiences at the Battle of Asiago.

mickey 17.title: Mickey 17
mickey 17.description: Mickey 17 is a 2025 science fiction black comedy film written, produced, and directed by Bong Joon Ho, based on the 2022 novel Mickey7 by Edward Ashton.

the dust of time.title: The Dust of Time
the dust of time.description: The Dust of Time (Greek: Η Σκόνη του Χρόνου) is a 2008 Greek drama film written and directed by Theodoros Angelopoulos, and starring Willem Dafoe, Irène Jacob, Bruno Ganz, Michel Piccoli and Christiane Paul.

how i lost the war.title: How I Lost the War
how i lost the war.description: How I Lost the War (Italian: Come persi la guerra) is a 1947 Italian comedy film directed by Carlo Borghesio and starring Erminio Macario.

difficult years.title: Difficult Years
difficult years.description: Difficult Years (Italian: Anni difficili) is a 1948 Italian drama film directed by Luigi Zampa and starring Umberto Spadaro, adapted from the 1946 short story Vecchio con gli stivali (Old Man in Boots), by the Sicilian author Vitaliano Brancati.

his days are numbered.title: His Days Are Numbered
his days are numbered.description: His Days Are Numbered (Italian: I giorni contati), also titled Numbered Days, is a 1962 Italian drama film directed by Elio Petri.

the rain people.title: The Rain People
the rain people.description: The Rain People is a 1969 American road drama film written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola, and starring Shirley Knight, James Caan and Robert Duvall. The film centers on a middle-class housewife (Knight), who runs away from her husband after learning she is pregnant.

cameriera bella presenza offresi.title: Cameriera bella presenza offresi...
cameriera bella presenza offresi.description: Cameriera bella presenza offresi... (English: Housemaid) is a 1951 Italian film directed by Giorgio Pastina. Federico Fellini was one of its scriptwriters. The film marked the comeback of Elsa Merlini after a nine years hiatus.

the leopard.title: The Leopard
the leopard.description: The Leopard (Italian: Il Gattopardo, lit. 'The Serval' [il ˌɡattoˈpardo]) is a 1963 epic historical drama film directed by Luchino Visconti. Written by Visconti, Suso Cecchi d'Amico, Enrico Medioli, Pasquale Festa Campanile, and Massimo Franciosa, the film is an adaptation of the 1958 novel by Giuseppe Tomasi di Lampedusa.

alice doesn t live here anymore.title: Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore
alice doesn t live here anymore.description: Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore is a 1974 American romantic comedy drama film directed by Martin Scorsese and written by Robert Getchell. It stars Ellen Burstyn as a widow who travels with her preteen son across the Southwestern United States in search of a better life.

the working class goes to heaven.title: The Working Class Goes to Heaven
the working class goes to heaven.wikipedia: The Working Class Goes to Heaven
the working class goes to heaven.description: The Working Class Goes to Heaven (Italian: La classe operaia va in paradiso), released in the US as Lulu the Tool, is a 1971 Italian satirical political drama film directed by Elio Petri. It depicts a factory worker's realisation of his own condition as a simple tool in the process of production.

property is no longer a theft.title: Property Is No Longer a Theft
property is no longer a theft.wikipedia: Property Is No Longer a Theft
property is no longer a theft.description: Property Is No Longer a Theft (Italian: La proprietà non è più un furto) is a 1973 Italian-French comedy drama film directed by Elio Petri.

struggle in italy.title: Struggle in Italy
struggle in italy.description: Struggle in Italy (Original title: Lotte in Italia) is an Italian-language drama film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard and Jean-Pierre Gorin that was released in 1971.

night drum.title: Night Drum
night drum.description: a. The Adulteress (Japanese: 夜の鼓, Hepburn: Yoru no tsuzumi) is a 1958 Japanese historical drama film directed by Tadashi Imai. It was written by Kaneto Shindō and Shinobu Hashimoto, based on the 1706 play Horikawa nami no tsuzumi by Monzaemon Chikamatsu.

empire of passion.title: Empire of Passion
empire of passion.description: Empire of Passion (Japanese: 愛の亡霊, Hepburn: Ai no Bōrei) is a 1978 French-Japanese film produced, written and directed by Nagisa Ōshima, based on a novel by Itoko Nakamura. The film was a co-production between Oshima Prods.

the paper chase.title: The Paper Chase
the paper chase.description: The Paper Chase is a 1973 American comedy-drama film starring Timothy Bottoms, Lindsay Wagner, and John Houseman, and directed by James Bridges.

the mattei affair.title: The Mattei Affair
the mattei affair.description: The Mattei Affair (Italian: Il Caso Mattei) is a 1972 Italian drama film directed by Francesco Rosi.

lucky luciano.title: Lucky Luciano
lucky luciano.description: Lucky Luciano is a 1973 biographical crime film about the Sicilian-American gangster Charles “Lucky” Luciano. It is directed by Francesco Rosi, and written by Rosi, Tonino Guerra, Lino Iannuzzi, and Jerome Chodorov.

christ stopped at eboli.title: Christ Stopped at Eboli
christ stopped at eboli.description: Christ Stopped at Eboli (Italian: Cristo si è fermato a Eboli), also known as Eboli in the United States, is a 1979 drama film directed by Francesco Rosi, adapted from the book of the same name by Carlo Levi.

three brothers.title: Three Brothers
three brothers.description: Three Brothers (Italian: Tre fratelli) is a 1981 Italian film based on a work by Russian author Andrei Platonov. It was directed by Francesco Rosi and stars Philippe Noiret, Vittorio Mezzogiorno, Michele Placido and Charles Vanel.

the beekeeper.title: The Beekeeper
the beekeeper.description: The Beekeeper (Greek: Ο Μελισσοκόμος, translit. O Melissokomos) is a 1986 Greek drama art film directed by Theodoros Angelopoulos. The film is the second installment in Angelopoulos's "trilogy of silence", preceded by Voyage to Cythera and followed by Landscape in the Mist.

chronicle of a death foretold.title: Chronicle of a Death Foretold
chronicle of a death foretold.description: Chronicle of a Death Foretold (Italian: Cronaca di una morte annunciata, Spanish: Crónica de una muerte anunciada) is a 1987 drama film directed by Francesco Rosi adapted by Tonino Guerra from the eponymous novella by the Colombian Nobel Prize-winning author Gabriel García Márquez.

the suspended step of the stork.title: The Suspended Step of the Stork
the suspended step of the stork.wikipedia: The Suspended Step of the Stork
the suspended step of the stork.description: The Suspended Step of the Stork (Greek: Το Mετέωρο Bήμα Tου Πελαργού, translit. To Meteoro Vima Tou Pelargou) is a 1991 Greek film directed by Theodoros Angelopoulos. It was entered into the 1991 Cannes Film Festival.

eternity and a day.title: Eternity and a Day
eternity and a day.description: Eternity and a Day (Greek: Μια αιωνιότητα και μια μέρα, romanized: Mia aioniótita kai mia méra) is a 1998 Greek drama film directed by Theo Angelopoulos, and starring Bruno Ganz, Isabelle Renauld and Fabrizio Bentivoglio.

a wife s heart.title: A Wife's Heart
a wife s heart.description: A Wife's Heart (Japanese: 妻の心, Hepburn: Tsuma no kokoro) is a 1956 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse.

casper.title: Casper
casper.description: Casper is a 1995 American supernatural fantasy comedy film based on the cartoon character Casper the Friendly Ghost. It was directed by Brad Silberling, in his feature directorial debut, and written by Sherri Stoner and Deanna Oliver.

solo con tu pareja.title: Sólo Con Tu Pareja
solo con tu pareja.wikipedia: Love in the Time of Hysteria
solo con tu pareja.description: Love in the Time of Hysteria (Spanish: Sólo con tu pareja, lit. '"Only with your partner"') is a 1991 Mexican romantic comedy film produced, co-written and directed by Alfonso Cuarón, in his feature-length directorial debut.

his last twelve hours.title: His Last Twelve Hours
his last twelve hours.description: ) is a 1951 French-Italian drama film directed by Luigi Zampa and starring Jean Gabin, Mariella Lotti and Elli Parvo. The film's sets were designed by the art director Gastone Medin. It was shot at the Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia near Cinecittà in Rome.

easy years.title: Easy Years
easy years.description: Easy Years (Italian: Anni facili) is a 1953 drama film directed by Luigi Zampa and starring Nino Taranto.

a pilot returns.title: A Pilot Returns
a pilot returns.description: A Pilot Returns (Italian: Un pilota ritorna) is a 1942 Italian war film directed by Roberto Rossellini and starring Massimo Girotti, Michela Belmonte and Piero Lulli. The film forms part of Rossellini's "Fascist trilogy" along with The White Ship (1941) and The Man with a Cross (1943).

torment.title: Torment
torment.description: Torment (Swedish: Hets) is a 1944 Swedish film, directed by Alf Sjöberg from a screenplay by Ingmar Bergman. The film, a tale of sex, passion and murder, was originally released as Frenzy in the United Kingdom, although later releases have used the US title.

woman without a face.title: Woman Without a Face
woman without a face.description: Woman Without a Face (Swedish: Kvinna utan ansikte) is a 1947 Swedish drama film directed by Gustaf Molander and written by Ingmar Bergman.

while the city sleeps.title: While the City Sleeps
while the city sleeps.description: While the City Sleeps (Swedish: Medan staden sover), is a 1950 Swedish crime drama film directed by Lars-Eric Kjellgren and starring Sven-Eric Gamble, Inga Landgré and Adolf Jahr. It is based on the novel Ligister ( "Gangsters") by Per Anders Fogelström, who also wrote the screenplay for the film.

the secret garden.title: The Secret Garden
the secret garden.description: The Secret Garden is a 1993 fantasy drama film directed by Agnieszka Holland, executive-produced by Francis Ford Coppola and distributed by Warner Bros. under their Family Entertainment imprint.

samurai banners.title: Samurai Banners
samurai banners.description: Samurai Banners (Japanese: 風林火山, Hepburn: Fūrin Kazan) is a Japanese samurai drama film released in 1969. It was directed by Hiroshi Inagaki and is based on the novel Furin kazan by Yasushi Inoue.

destiny.title: Destiny
destiny.description: Destiny (German: Der müde Tod: ein deutsches Volkslied in sechs Versen, lit. 'The Weary Death: A German Folksong in Six Verses') is a 1921 silent German Expressionist fantasy romance film directed by Fritz Lang and inspired by the Indian folktale of Savitri.

mother 1952.title: Mother
mother 1952.description: Mother (おかあさん, Okaasan) is a 1952 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse starring Kinuyo Tanaka in the title role. The screenplay by Yoko Mizuki is based on the prize-winning entry of a school essay-writing competition.

the misfits.title: The Misfits
the misfits.description: The Misfits is a 1961 American romantic drama film directed by John Huston and written by Arthur Miller, who adapted his own 1957 short story. It stars Clark Gable, Marilyn Monroe, and Montgomery Clift, alongside Thelma Ritter and Eli Wallach.

lemony snicket s a series of unfortunate.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
lemony snicket s a series of unfortunate.wikipedia: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
lemony snicket s a series of unfortunate.description: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events (also known as A Series of Unfortunate Events) is a 2004 American adventure dark comedy film directed by Brad Silberling and written by Robert Gordon, based on the first three novels of the book series A Series of Unfortunate Events.

the mountain eagle.title: The Mountain Eagle
the mountain eagle.description: The Mountain Eagle is a 1926 lost silent film directed by Alfred Hitchcock following his debut in The Pleasure Garden. The film, a romantic drama set in Kentucky, is about a widower (Bernhard Goetzke) who jealously competes with his crippled son (John F.

mr sleeman is coming.title: Mr. Sleeman Is Coming
mr sleeman is coming.description: Mr. Sleeman Is Coming (Swedish: Herr Sleeman kommer) is a 1917 one-act play by the Swedish author Hjalmar Bergman. The main character is an orphaned young woman who is about to be married off to an unappealing but rich old man, Mr.

rabies.title: Rabies
rabies.description: Rabies is a 1958 Swedish television drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman. The film depicts domino frustrations of how those who are rejected or oppressed take it out on someone else.

torn curtain.title: Torn Curtain
torn curtain.description: Torn Curtain is a 1966 American spy political thriller film directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Paul Newman and Julie Andrews. Written by Brian Moore, the film is set in the Cold War and concerns an American scientist who appears to defect behind the Iron Curtain to East Germany.

the making of fanny and alexander.title: The Making of Fanny and Alexander
the making of fanny and alexander.wikipedia: The Making of Fanny and Alexander
the making of fanny and alexander.description: The Making of Fanny and Alexander (Swedish: Dokument Fanny och Alexander) is a 1984 Swedish documentary film directed by Ingmar Bergman which traces the making of his film Fanny and Alexander. Its running length is 110 minutes and it is photographed by Arne Carlsson.

kinds of kindness.title: Kinds of Kindness
kinds of kindness.description: Kinds of Kindness is a 2024 absurdist black comedy-drama anthology film directed by Yorgos Lanthimos from a screenplay he co-wrote with Efthimis Filippou. It stars Emma Stone, Jesse Plemons, Willem Dafoe, Margaret Qualley, Hong Chau, Joe Alwyn, and Mamoudou Athie, in a triple role each, and Hunter Schafer in a supporting role.

effi briest.title: Effi Briest
effi briest.description: Effi Briest (also known as Fontane Effi Briest; original title: Fontane Effi Briest oder Viele, die eine Ahnung haben von ihren Möglichkeiten und Bedürfnissen und trotzdem das herrschende System in ihrem Kopf akzeptieren durch ihre Taten und es somit festigen und durchaus bestätigen, literally Fontane Effi Briest or Many people who are aware of their own capabilities and needs just acquiesce to the prevailing system in their thoughts and deeds, thereby confirming and reinforcing it) is a 1974 West German black-and-white historical drama film directed, written and narrated by Rainer Werner Fassbinder.

a guide for the married man.title: A Guide for the Married Man
a guide for the married man.wikipedia: A Guide for the Married Man
a guide for the married man.description: A Guide for the Married Man is a 1967 American bedroom-farce comedy film directed by Gene Kelly and starring Walter Matthau, Inger Stevens, and Robert Morse. It features many cameos, including those by Lucille Ball, Jack Benny, Terry-Thomas, Jayne Mansfield, Sid Caesar, Carl Reiner, Joey Bishop, Art Carney, and Wally Cox.

weak spot.title: Weak Spot
weak spot.description: Weak Spot (French: La faille, Italian: La smagliatura, German: Der dritte Grad) is a 1975 French-Italian-German thriller film directed by Peter Fleischmann. It is based on the novel The Flaw by Antonis Samarakis.

cigarettes coffee.title: Cigarettes & Coffee
cigarettes coffee.description: Cigarettes & Coffee is a 1993 short film written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, and starring Philip Baker Hall. It tells the story of five people connected through a $20 bill. Anderson later used it as a basis for his directorial debut film Hard Eight.

british sounds.title: British Sounds
british sounds.description: British Sounds (also known as See You at Mao) is an hour-long avant-garde documentary film shot in February 1969 for television, written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard and Jean-Henri Roger, and produced by Irving Teitelbaum and Kenith Trodd.

letter to jane.title: Letter to Jane
letter to jane.description: Letter to Jane is a 1972 French postscript film to Tout Va Bien directed by Jean-Luc Godard and Jean-Pierre Gorin and made under the auspices of the Dziga Vertov Group.

helas pour moi.title: Hélas pour moi
helas pour moi.description: Hélas pour moi (English: Alas for Me or Oh Woe Is Me) is a 1993 French film directed by Jean-Luc Godard and starring Gérard Depardieu. This film is inspired by the legend of Alcmene and Amphitryon and attempts to show the desire of a god to experience the truth of human desire, suffering and pleasure.

film socialisme.title: Film Socialisme
film socialisme.description: Film Socialisme (alternative French title Socialisme; English: Socialism but often referred to as Film Socialism) is a 2010 French postmodern drama film directed by Jean-Luc Godard.

memoirs of an invisible man.title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
memoirs of an invisible man.description: Memoirs of an Invisible Man is a 1992 American science fiction black comedy film directed by John Carpenter and starring Chevy Chase, Daryl Hannah, Sam Neill, Michael McKean and Stephen Tobolowsky.F. Saint.

voyage to cythera.title: Voyage to Cythera
voyage to cythera.description: Voyage to Cythera (Greek: Ταξίδι στα Κύθηρα, translit. Taxidi sta Kythira) is a 1984 Greek drama film directed by Theodoros Angelopoulos, and starring Manos Katrakis. It was entered into the 1984 Cannes Film Festival, where it won the FIPRESCI Prize and the award for Best Screenplay, where it was also nominated for the Palme D'or.

nazarin.title: Nazarín
nazarin.description: Nazarín (Latin American Spanish: [nasaˈɾin]) is a 1959 Mexican satirical drama film directed by Luis Buñuel and co-written between Buñuel and Julio Alejandro, adapted from the eponymous novel of Benito Pérez Galdós.

michael.title: Michael
michael.description: Michael (also known as Mikaël, Chained: The Story of the Third Sex, and Heart's Desire) is a 1924 German silent drama film directed by Carl Theodor Dreyer. The film stars Walter Slezak as the titular Michael, the young assistant and model to the artist Claude Zoret (Benjamin Christensen).

with honors.title: With Honors
with honors.description: With Honors is a 1994 American comedy-drama film directed by Alek Keshishian. It stars Brendan Fraser as a Harvard University student who finds himself at the mercy of the demands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) when he holds his senior thesis paper hostage.

the war is over.title: The War Is Over
the war is over.description: The War Is Over (French: La Guerre est finie) is a 1966 French war drama film about a leftist in Franco's Spain, directed by Alain Resnais and starring Yves Montand, Ingrid Thulin and Geneviève Bujold. Joseph Losey directed a sequel, Roads to the South (French: Les Routes du Sud-1978).

empire of light.title: Empire of Light
empire of light.description: Empire of Light is a 2022 romantic drama film directed, written, and co-produced by Sam Mendes. Set in an English coastal town in the early 1980s, the film is about the power of human connection during turbulent times.

older brother younger sister.title: Older Brother, Younger Sister
older brother younger sister.description: Older Brother, Younger Sister (Japanese: あにいもうと, Hepburn: Ani imōto) is a 1953 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse. The film is based on the short story Ani imōto by Saisei Murō.

suzakumon.title: Suzakumon
suzakumon.description: Suzakumon (Japanese: 朱雀門), also known as The Love of a Princess in English, is a 1957 color Japanese film directed by Kazuo Mori and based on a novel by Matsutarō Kawaguchi. At the 1957 Asia-Pacific Film Festival the film won awards for best film and best cinematography (Kazuo Miyagawa).

peau d ane.title: Peau d'Âne
peau d ane.description: Donkey Skin (French: Peau d'âne; also known in English as Once Upon a Time and The Magic Donkey) is a 1970 French surrealist fantasy musical romantic comedy film directed by Jacques Demy, based on Donkeyskin, a 1695 fairy tale by Charles Perrault about a king who wishes to marry his own daughter.

downhill.title: Downhill
downhill.description: Downhill is a 1927 British silent drama film directed by Alfred Hitchcock, starring Ivor Novello, Robin Irvine and Isabel Jeans, and based on the play Down Hill by Novello and Constance Collier. The film was produced by Gainsborough Pictures at their Islington studios.

the manxman.title: The Manxman
the manxman.description: The Manxman is a 1929 British silent romance film directed by Alfred Hitchcock and starring Anny Ondra, Carl Brisson and Malcolm Keen. The film is based on a popular 1894 romantic novel The Manxman by Hall Caine, which had previously been made into a film 13 years earlier.

elstree calling.title: Elstree Calling
elstree calling.description: Elstree Calling is a 1930 British comedy musical film directed by Adrian Brunel and Alfred Hitchcock at Elstree Studios.

the fighting generation.title: The Fighting Generation
the fighting generation.description: The Fighting Generation is a 1944 short film, a public service announcement produced by David O. Selznick and directed by an uncredited Alfred Hitchcock to promote war bond sales during the Sixth War Loan Drive.

the venetian.title: The Venetian
the venetian.description: The Venetian (Swedish: Venetianskan) is a 1958 Swedish television drama film directed by Ingmar Bergman, based on the 16th century Italian play La Venexiana written by an anonymous playwright.

faro document.title: Fårö Document
faro document.description: Fårö Document is a 1970 Swedish documentary film directed by Ingmar Bergman. It was shot on the island of Fårö and is about its inhabitants.

falling in love.title: Falling in Love
falling in love.description: Falling in Love is a 1984 American romantic drama film directed by Ulu Grosbard, written by Michael Cristofer and starring Robert De Niro and Meryl Streep. Released on November 21, 1984, the film received mixed reviews from critics and grossed $11 million.

the image makers.title: The Image Makers
the image makers.description: The Image Makers (Swedish: Bildmakarna) is a 2000 Swedish television play directed by Ingmar Bergman and written by Per Olov Enquist. The drama is set in the year 1920 at Filmstaden where the film director Victor Sjöström is shooting the film The Phantom Carriage, an adaptation of Selma Lagerlöf's novel Thy Soul Shall Bear Witness!

german concentration camps factual surve.title: German Concentration Camps Factual Survey
german concentration camps factual surve.description: German Concentration Camps Factual Survey is the official British documentary film on the Nazi concentration camps, based on footage shot by the Allied forces in 1945. The film was produced by Sidney Bernstein, then with the British Ministry of Information, with Alfred Hitchcock acting as a "treatment advisor".

ingmar bergman s cinema.title: Ingmar Bergman's Cinema
ingmar bergman s cinema.description: Ingmar Bergman's Cinema is a Blu-ray disc box set featuring 39 films directed by Ingmar Bergman, released by the Criterion Collection on November 20, 2018 in the United States. The set spans Bergman's early career, beginning in the 1940s, up to his final film in 2003.

monsieur verdoux.title: Monsieur Verdoux
monsieur verdoux.description: Monsieur Verdoux is a 1947 American black comedy film directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin, who plays a bigamist wife killer inspired by serial killer Henri Désiré Landru. The supporting cast includes Martha Raye, William Frawley, and Marilyn Nash.

the 47 ronin.title: The 47 Ronin
the 47 ronin.description: The 47 Ronin (元禄 忠臣蔵, Genroku Chūshingura; "The Treasury of Loyal Retainers of the Genroku Era") is a black-and-white two-part jidaigeki Japanese film directed by Kenji Mizoguchi, adapted from a play by Seika Mayama.

faithless.title: Faithless
faithless.description: Faithless (Swedish: Trolösa) is a Swedish film directed by Liv Ullmann from a script by Ingmar Bergman. The story is loosely based on experiences of adultery from Bergman's own life. It was entered into the 2000 Cannes Film Festival.

arrietty.title: Arrietty
arrietty.description: Arrietty, titled Arrietty the Borrower in Japan and The Secret World of Arrietty in North America, is a 2010 Japanese animated fantasy film directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi as his feature film debut as a director, animated by Studio Ghibli for the Nippon Television Network, Dentsu, Hakuhodo DY Media Partners, Walt Disney Japan, Mitsubishi, Toho and Wild Bunch.

star wars episode iii revenge of the sit.title: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith
star wars episode iii revenge of the sit.wikipedia: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith
star wars episode iii revenge of the sit.description: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith is a 2005 American epic space opera film written and directed by George Lucas. The sequel to Attack of the Clones (2002), it is the sixth film in the Star Wars film series, the third installment in the Star Wars prequel trilogy, and the third chronological chapter of the "Skywalker Saga".

carmen.title: Carmen
carmen.description: Carmen is a 1984 French-Italian film directed by Francesco Rosi. It is a film version of Bizet's opera, Carmen. Julia Migenes stars in the title role, Plácido Domingo as Don José, Ruggero Raimondi as Escamillo, and Faith Esham as Micaela.

the dove.title: The Dove
the dove.description: The Dove is a 1974 American-British biographical film directed by Charles Jarrott. The picture was produced by Gregory Peck, the third and last feature film he produced.

crimes and misdemeanors.title: Crimes and Misdemeanors
crimes and misdemeanors.description: Crimes and Misdemeanors is a 1989 American existential comedy-drama film written and directed by Woody Allen, who stars alongside Martin Landau, Mia Farrow, Anjelica Huston, Jerry Orbach, Alan Alda, Sam Waterston, and Joanna Gleason.

autumn has already started.title: Autumn Has Already Started
autumn has already started.description: The Approach of Autumn (秋立ちぬ, Aki tachinu), also titled Autumn Has Already Started, is a 1960 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse. It was written by Ryōzō Kasahara.

waterland.title: Waterland
waterland.description: Waterland is a 1992 British-American mystery drama film directed by Stephen Gyllenhaal, and starring Jeremy Irons, Sinéad Cusack, Ethan Hawke, Lena Headey and Pete Postlethwaite. It is based on Graham Swift's 1983 novel of the same name.

a dangerous woman.title: A Dangerous Woman
a dangerous woman.description: A Dangerous Woman is a 1993 American romantic drama film directed by Stephen Gyllenhaal. The screenplay was written by his wife Naomi Foner, loosely based on the award-winning novel of the same name by Mary McGarry Morris.

the flowers of st francis.title: The Flowers of St. Francis
the flowers of st francis.description: The Flowers of St. Francis (in Italian, Francesco, giullare di Dio, or "Francis, God's Jester") is a 1950 film directed by Roberto Rossellini and co-written by Federico Fellini. The film is based on two books, the 14th-century novel Fioretti di San Francesco (Little Flowers of St.

hitokiri.title: Hitokiri
hitokiri.description: Hitokiri (Japanese: 人斬り) (released as Tenchu! in the United States) is a 1969 Japanese samurai film directed by Hideo Gosha set during the end of the Tokugawa shogunate and based on the lives of the historical Four Hitokiri of the Bakumatsu.

memoirs of a geisha.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
memoirs of a geisha.description: Memoirs of a Geisha is a 2005 American epic period drama film directed by Rob Marshall and adapted by Robin Swicord from the 1997 novel of the same name by Arthur Golden.

the lizards.title: The Lizards
the lizards.description: The Lizards, also known as The Basilisks (Italian: I basilischi), is a 1963 Italian comedy drama film written and directed by Lina Wertmüller.

jolanda the daughter of the black corsai.title: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
jolanda the daughter of the black corsai.wikipedia: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
jolanda the daughter of the black corsai.description: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair, also known as Yolanda (Italian: Jolanda, la figlia del corsaro nero) is a 1953 Italian film directed by Mario Soldati, and based on the novel Yolanda, the Black Corsair's Daughter by Emilio Salgari.

the general line.title: The General Line
the general line.description: The General Line, also known as Old and New (Russian: Старое и новое, romanized: Staroye i novoye), is a 1929 Soviet propaganda film directed by Sergei Eisenstein and Grigori Aleksandrov. The General Line was begun in 1927 as a celebration of the collectivization of agriculture, as championed by old-line Bolshevik Leon Trotsky.

two men in manhattan.title: Two Men in Manhattan
two men in manhattan.description: Two Men in Manhattan (French: Deux hommes dans Manhattan) is a 1959 French film noir written and directed by Jean-Pierre Melville. It stars Melville and Pierre Grasset as two French journalists in New York City who are searching for a missing United Nations diplomat.

leonor.title: Léonor
leonor.description: Léonor (also known as Mistress of the Devil) is a 1975 French-Italian-Spanish horror film written and directed by Juan Luis Buñuel (the son of Luis Buñuel) and starring Michel Piccoli, Liv Ullmann and Ornella Muti.

rocco and his brothers.title: Rocco and His Brothers
rocco and his brothers.description: Rocco and His Brothers (Italian: Rocco e i suoi fratelli) is a 1960 epic melodrama film directed by Luchino Visconti and starring Alain Delon, Annie Girardot, Renato Salvatori, Katina Paxinou, Roger Hanin, Paolo Stoppa, and Claudia Cardinale in one of her early roles.

the merchant of four seasons.title: The Merchant of Four Seasons
the merchant of four seasons.description: The Merchant of Four Seasons (German: Händler der vier Jahreszeiten) is a 1972 West German film written and directed by Rainer Werner Fassbinder, starring Hans Hirschmüller and Irm Hermann. The plot follows the life of a fruit-peddler, living in 1950s Munich.

bushido samurai saga.title: Bushido, Samurai Saga
bushido samurai saga.description: Bushido, Samurai Saga (武士道残酷物語, Bushidō zankoku monogatari), also titled Bushido: The Cruel Code of the Samurai and Cruel Tales of Bushido, is a 1963 Japanese drama and jidaigeki film directed by Tadashi Imai.

campane a martello.title: Campane a martello
campane a martello.description: Alarm Bells (Italian: Campane a martello) is a 1949 Italian drama film directed by Luigi Zampa and starring Gina Lollobrigida, Yvonne Sanson and Eduardo De Filippo. Location shooting took place on Ischia in the Gulf of Naples.

pret a porter.title: Prêt-à-Porter
pret a porter.description: Prêt-à-Porter, released in the United States as Ready to Wear (Prêt-à-Porter), is a 1994 American satirical comedy-drama film co-written, directed, and produced by Robert Altman and shot on location during the Paris Fashion Week with a host of international stars, models, and designers.

the sailor from gibraltar.title: The Sailor from Gibraltar
the sailor from gibraltar.description: The Sailor from Gibraltar is a 1967 British romantic drama film directed by Tony Richardson and starring Jeanne Moreau, Ian Bannen, Vanessa Redgrave, Hugh Griffith and Orson Welles.

the young girls turn 25.title: The Young Girls Turn 25
the young girls turn 25.description: The Young Girls Turn 25 (French: Les demoiselles ont eu 25 ans) is a 1993 French documentary film directed by Agnès Varda, about Jacques Demy's 1967 film The Young Girls of Rochefort. It was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1993 Cannes Film Festival.

la luna.title: La Luna
la luna.description: La Luna (released in the United States as Luna) is a 1979 drama film directed by Bernardo Bertolucci from a screenplay co-written with his brother Giuseppe and wife Clare Peploe. The film concerns the troubled life of a teenage boy and his relationship with his parents, including an incestuous relationship with his opera singer mother.

mountains of the moon.title: Mountains of the Moon
mountains of the moon.description: Mountains of the Moon is a 1990 American biographical film depicting the 1857–1858 journey of Richard Francis Burton and John Hanning Speke in their expedition to Central Africa, which culminated in Speke's discovery of the source of the Nile River and led to a bitter rivalry between the two men.

to love.title: To Love
to love.description: To Love (Swedish: Att Älska) is a 1964 Swedish drama film written and directed by Jörn Donner. For her performance Harriet Andersson was awarded Volpi Cup for Best Actress at the 25th Venice International Film Festival.

the desert of the tartars.title: The Desert of the Tartars
the desert of the tartars.description: The Desert of the Tartars (Italian: Il deserto dei Tartari) is a 1976 Italian film by director Valerio Zurlini with an international cast including Jacques Perrin, Vittorio Gassman, Max von Sydow, Francisco Rabal, Philippe Noiret, Fernando Rey, and Jean-Louis Trintignant.

solo a star wars story.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
solo a star wars story.description: Solo: A Star Wars Story is a 2018 American space Western film directed by Ron Howard and written by Jonathan and Lawrence Kasdan., and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is the second Star Wars anthology film, following Rogue One (2016).

simon of the desert.title: Simon of the Desert
simon of the desert.description: Simon of the Desert (Spanish: Simón del desierto) is a 1965 Mexican surrealist satirical comedy film co-written and directed by Luis Buñuel, starring Claudio Brook and Silvia Pinal. It is loosely based on the life of the ascetic 5th-century Syrian Christian saint Simeon Stylites, who lived for 36 years on top of a pillar.

bad lieutenant port of call new orleans.title: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans
bad lieutenant port of call new orleans.wikipedia: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans
bad lieutenant port of call new orleans.description: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans is a 2009 American black comedy crime drama film directed by Werner Herzog, written by William Finkelstein, and starring Nicolas Cage, Eva Mendes, Val Kilmer, and Alvin 'Xzibit' Joiner.

that obscure object of desire.title: That Obscure Object of Desire
that obscure object of desire.description: That Obscure Object of Desire (French: Cet obscur objet du désir, Spanish: Ese oscuro objeto del deseo) is a 1977 absurdist satirical comedy-drama film directed by Luis Buñuel, based on the 1898 novel The Woman and the Puppet by Pierre Louÿs.

gonza the spearman.title: Gonza the Spearman
gonza the spearman.description: Gonza the Spearman (Japanese: 近松門左衛門 鑓の権三, Hepburn: Yari no gonza) is a 1986 Japanese drama film directed by Masahiro Shinoda. It was entered into the 36th Berlin International Film Festival, where it won the Silver Bear for outstanding artistic contribution.

the thief of paris.title: The Thief of Paris
the thief of paris.description: The Thief of Paris (Le voleur) is a 1967 French crime film directed by Louis Malle and starring Jean-Paul Belmondo as a professional thief (Georges Randal) at the turn of the century in Paris. The film is based on a book of the same title by Georges Darien.

escape to france.title: Escape to France
escape to france.description: Escape to France (Italian: Fuga in Francia) is a 1948 Italian drama film directed by Mario Soldati and starring Folco Lulli, Enrico Olivieri and Rosi Mirafiore. The film's sets were designed by the art director Piero Gherardi.

vergine moderna.title: Vergine moderna
vergine moderna.description: Modern Virgin (Italian: Vergine moderna) is a 1954 Italian melodrama film. It stars actor Gabriele Ferzetti.

the last days of pompeii.title: The Last Days of Pompeii
the last days of pompeii.wikipedia: The Last Days of Pompeii (1959 film)
the last days of pompeii.description: The Last Days of Pompeii (Italian: Gli ultimi giorni di Pompei) is a 1959 Eastmancolor historical disaster action film starring Steve Reeves, Christine Kaufmann, and Fernando Rey and directed by Mario Bonnard and Sergio Leone.

notebook on cities and clothes.title: Notebook on Cities and Clothes
notebook on cities and clothes.description: Notebook on Cities and Clothes (German: Aufzeichnungen zu Kleidern und Städten) is a 1989 documentary film about Yohji Yamamoto directed by Wim Wenders. Despite Wender's previous disdain for fashion, he undertook filming after being commissioned by the Pompidou Center in Paris.

buena vista social club.title: Buena Vista Social Club
buena vista social club.description: Buena Vista Social Club is a 1999 documentary film directed by Wim Wenders about the music of Cuba, featuring the musicians who recorded the 1997 album Buena Vista Social Club. The film is an international co-production of Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, and Cuba.

the salt of the earth.title: The Salt of the Earth
the salt of the earth.wikipedia: The Salt of the Earth (2014 film)
the salt of the earth.description: The Salt of the Earth (also released under the French title Le sel de la terre) is a 2014 internationally co-produced biographical documentary film directed by Wim Wenders and Juliano Ribeiro Salgado. It portrays the works of Salgado's father, the Brazilian photographer Sebastião Salgado.

pope francis a man of his word.title: Pope Francis: A Man of His Word
pope francis a man of his word.wikipedia: Pope Francis: A Man of His Word
pope francis a man of his word.description: Pope Francis: A Man of His Word is a 2018 documentary film produced, co-written and directed by Wim Wenders, focusing on the life and goals of Pope Francis, the 266th Pope and sovereign of the Vatican City State.

the hellbenders.title: The Hellbenders
the hellbenders.description: The Hellbenders (Italian: I crudeli, lit. 'The Cruel Ones') is a 1967 Spaghetti Western film directed by Sergio Corbucci and starring Joseph Cotten, Norma Bengell, Julián Mateos, Gino Pernice and Ángel Aranda.

wings of hope.title: Wings of Hope
wings of hope.description: Wings of Hope (German: Julianes Sturz in den Dschungel, literally "Juliane's Fall into the Jungle") is a 1998 made-for-TV documentary directed by Werner Herzog.

que viva mexico.title: ¡Que viva México!
que viva mexico.description: ¡Que viva México!) is a film project begun in 1930 by the Russian avant-garde director Sergei Eisenstein (1898–1948) under contract to socialist author Upton Sinclair and other supporters in the United States.

the glass cell.title: The Glass Cell
the glass cell.description: The Glass Cell (German: Die gläserne Zelle) is a 1978 West German crime film directed by Hans W. Geißendörfer and starring Brigitte Fossey, Helmut Griem, and Dieter Laser. It is based on the 1964 novel of the same name by Patricia Highsmith.

the ceremony.title: The Ceremony
the ceremony.description: The Ceremony (Japanese: 儀式, Hepburn: Gishiki) is a 1971 Japanese drama film directed by Nagisa Ōshima, starring Kenzo Kawarasaki and Atsuko Kaku.

un flic.title: Un flic
un flic.description: Un flic (lit. 'A Cop') is a 1972 crime film directed and written by Jean-Pierre Melville. The film is about a Parisian nightclub owner named Simon who leads four men to carry out on a bank robbery. One is seriously wounded and taken to a clinic.

eyes of laura mars.title: Eyes of Laura Mars
eyes of laura mars.description: Eyes of Laura Mars is a 1978 American neo-noir supernatural horror thriller film directed by Irvin Kershner and starring Faye Dunaway, Tommy Lee Jones, Brad Dourif, René Auberjonois, and Raul Julia.

youth without youth.title: Youth Without Youth
youth without youth.description: Youth Without Youth is a 2007 fantasy drama film written, directed, and produced by Francis Ford Coppola, based on the novella of the same name by Romanian author Mircea Eliade. The film is a co-production between the United States, Romania, France, Italy and Germany.

megalopolis.title: Megalopolis
megalopolis.description: Megalopolis is a 2024 American epic science fiction drama film written, directed, and produced by Francis Ford Coppola.

our time will come.title: Our Time Will Come
our time will come.description: Our Time Will Come (Chinese: 明月幾時有) is a 2017 war film directed by Ann Hui, starring Zhou Xun, Eddie Peng and Wallace Huo. It revolves around the resistance movement during the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong.

a genius two partners and a dupe.title: A Genius, Two Partners and a Dupe
a genius two partners and a dupe.wikipedia: A Genius, Two Partners and a Dupe
a genius two partners and a dupe.description: A Genius, Two Partners and a Dupe (Italian: Un genio, due compari, un pollo) is a 1975 Spaghetti Western comedy film directed by Damiano Damiani. It was co-written and produced by Sergio Leone, who also directed the opening scene.

a mother should be loved.title: A Mother Should be Loved
a mother should be loved.description: A Mother Should Be Loved (母を恋はずや, Haha o kowazuya) is a 1934 Japanese film directed by Yasujirō Ozu, the first and last reels of which have been lost. Ozu had wanted to name the film Tokyo Twilight, but studio executives preferred a title that referenced motherhood, a popular theme in Japanese cinema at the time of release.

the only son.title: The Only Son
the only son.description: The Only Son (一人息子, Hitori musuko) is a 1936 Japanese film directed by Yasujirō Ozu, starring Chōko Iida and Shin'ichi Himori. The film was Ozu's first sound film feature.

the fury.title: The Fury
the fury.description: The Fury is a 1978 American supernatural horror thriller film directed by Brian De Palma, and starring Kirk Douglas, John Cassavetes, Amy Irving, Carrie Snodgress, Charles Durning, and Andrew Stevens.

star wars episode i the phantom menace.title: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace
star wars episode i the phantom menace.wikipedia: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace
star wars episode i the phantom menace.description: Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace is a 1999 American epic space opera film written and directed by George Lucas in his first directorial effort since the original Star Wars, released in 1977. Produced by Lucasfilm Ltd.

star wars episode ii attack of the clone.title: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones
star wars episode ii attack of the clone.wikipedia: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones
star wars episode ii attack of the clone.description: Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones is a 2002 American epic space opera film directed by George Lucas from a screenplay he co-wrote with Jonathan Hales. The sequel to The Phantom Menace (1999), it is the fifth entry in the Star Wars film series and second chronological chapter of the "Skywalker Saga".

mata hari agent h 21.title: Mata Hari, agent H 21
mata hari agent h 21.description: Mata Hari, Agent H21 (Italian: Mata-Hari, agente segreto H21) is a 1964 French-Italian spy film directed by Jean-Louis Richard and starring Jeanne Moreau, Jean-Louis Trintignant and Claude Rich. It portrays the activities of the First World War spy Mata Hari.

something s gotta give.title: Something's Gotta Give
something s gotta give.description: Something's Gotta Give is a 2003 American romantic comedy drama film written, produced, and directed by Nancy Meyers. It stars Jack Nicholson and Diane Keaton as professionals who find love for each other in later life, despite being complete opposites.

red lion.title: Red Lion
red lion.description: Red Lion (Japanese: 赤毛, Hepburn: Akage) is a 1969 Japanese film directed by Kihachi Okamoto and starring Toshirō Mifune and Shima Iwashita.

finishing school.title: Finishing School
finishing school.description: Finishing School (Italian: Fanciulle di lusso) is a 1953 French-Italian comedy film directed by Bernard Vorhaus and starring Susan Stephen, Anna Maria Ferrero and Jacques Sernas. It was made at Cinecittà with sets designed by the art director Franco Lolli.

stereo.title: Stereo
stereo.description: Stereo (full title Stereo (Tile 3B of a CAEE Educational Mosaic)) is a 1969 Canadian science fiction film directed, written, produced, shot and edited by David Cronenberg in his feature film debut.

crimes of the future 1970.title: Crimes of the Future
crimes of the future 1970.description: Crimes of the Future is a 1970 Canadian science fiction film written, shot, edited and directed by David Cronenberg. Like Cronenberg's previous feature, Stereo, Crimes of the Future was shot silent with a commentary added afterwards, spoken by the character Adrian Tripod (Ronald Mlodzik).

tidal wave.title: Tidal Wave
tidal wave.description: Submersion of Japan (Japanese: 日本沈没, Hepburn: Nihon Chinbotsu; lit. 'Japan Sinks') is a Japanese disaster film directed by Shirō Moritani in 1973. It is based on the 1973 novel Japan Sinks by Sakyo Komatsu.

shivers.title: Shivers
shivers.description: Shivers, also known as The Parasite Murders and They Came from Within, and, for Canadian distribution in French, Frissons (IPA: free-SOHN; 'chills' or 'shivers'), is a 1975 Canadian science fiction body horror film written and directed by David Cronenberg and starring Paul Hampton, Lynn Lowry, and Barbara Steele.

rabid.title: Rabid
rabid.description: Rabid is a 1977 body horror film written and directed by David Cronenberg, and starring Marilyn Chambers, Frank Moore, Joe Silver, and Howard Ryshpan.

the calm.title: The Calm
the calm.description: The Calm (Polish: Spokój) is a film by Polish director Krzysztof Kieślowski made in 1976 but not exhibited until broadcast on Polish television in 1980. It starred Jerzy Stuhr, Izabella Olszewska, and Jerzy Trela.

the ox.title: The Ox
the ox.description: The Ox (Swedish: Oxen) is a 1991 Swedish drama film directed by Sven Nykvist. Collaborating with Lasse Summanen, Nykvist penned the screenplay adapted from the 1981 novel Oxen by Siv Cedering. The film was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film at the 64th Academy Awards in 1992.

the third murder.title: The Third Murder
the third murder.description: The Third Murder (Japanese: 三度目の殺人, Hepburn: Sandome no Satsujin) is a 2017 Japanese legal thriller film written, directed and edited by Hirokazu Kore-eda. It was screened in the main competition section of the 74th Venice International Film Festival.

death rides a horse.title: Death Rides a Horse
death rides a horse.description: Death Rides a Horse (Italian: Da uomo a uomo, lit. 'From man to man') is a 1967 Italian spaghetti Western directed by Giulio Petroni, written by Luciano Vincenzoni and starring Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law.

pirates.title: Pirates
pirates.description: Pirates is a 1986 adventure comedy film written by Gérard Brach, John Brownjohn and Roman Polanski, and directed by Polanski. It was inspired by Polanski's love of classic pirate films, as well as Disneyland's Pirates of the Caribbean attraction.

the thing from another world.title: The Thing from Another World
the thing from another world.description: The Thing from Another World, sometimes referred to as just The Thing, is a 1951 American black-and-white science fiction horror film directed by Christian Nyby, produced by Edward Lasker for Howard Hawks' Winchester Pictures Corporation, and released by RKO Radio Pictures.

the decameron.title: The Decameron
the decameron.description: The Decameron (Italian: Il Decameron) is a 1971 anthology erotic comedy film written and directed by Pier Paolo Pasolini, based on the 14th-century collection of stories by Giovanni Boccaccio. It is the first film of Pasolini's Trilogy of Life, the others being The Canterbury Tales and Arabian Nights.

bitter moon.title: Bitter Moon
bitter moon.description: Bitter Moon is a 1992 erotic romantic thriller film co-written and directed by Roman Polanski. It stars Peter Coyote, Emmanuelle Seigner, Hugh Grant and Kristin Scott Thomas. The film's French title, Lunes de fiel, is a pun on the French phrase "lune de miel", meaning "honeymoon".

the professional.title: The Professional
the professional.description: The Professional (original title: Le Professionnel [lə pʁɔfɛsjɔnɛl]) is a 1981 French action thriller film directed by Georges Lautner. The film stars Jean-Paul Belmondo as the title role. The film is based on the award-winning 1976 novel Death of a Thin-Skinned Animal by Patrick Alexander.

hannibal.title: Hannibal
