The film follows three generations of residents of Chengdu in the 1950s, the 1970s and the present, as a state-owned factory gives way to a modern apartment complex.

kinsey.title: Kinsey
kinsey.description: Kinsey is a 2004 American biographical drama film written and directed by Bill Condon. It describes the life of Alfred Charles Kinsey (played by Liam Neeson), a pioneer in the area of sexology.

last pair out.title: Last Pair Out
last pair out.description: Last Pair Out (Swedish: Sista paret ut), is a 1956 Swedish drama film directed by Alf Sjöberg and written by Ingmar Bergman. It was entered into the 7th Berlin International Film Festival.

menage all italiana.title: Menage all'italiana
menage all italiana.description: Menage all'italiana, also known as Menage Italian Style, is a 1965 Italian comedy film directed by Franco Indovina. It follows the story of a bigamist who cannot resist getting married again and again. He has eight wives.

a little night music.title: A Little Night Music
a little night music.description: A Little Night Music (German: Das Lächeln einer Sommernacht) is a 1977 musical romantic comedy film directed by Harold Prince, his second and final directorial role.

mission impossible 2.title: Mission: Impossible 2
mission impossible 2.description: Mission: Impossible 2 (titled onscreen as Mission: Impossible II and abbreviated as M:i-2) is a 2000 American action spy film directed by John Woo from a screenplay by Robert Towne, and produced by and starring Tom Cruise.

europe 51.title: Europe '51
europe 51.description: Europe '51 (Italian: Europa '51), also known as The Greatest Love, is a 1952 Italian neorealist film directed by Roberto Rossellini, starring Ingrid Bergman and Alexander Knox. The film follows an industrialist's wife who, after the death of her young son, turns towards a rigorous humanitarianism.

the rare breed.title: The Rare Breed
the rare breed.description: The Rare Breed is a 1966 American Western film directed by Andrew V. McLaglen and starring James Stewart, Maureen O'Hara and Brian Keith in Panavision. Loosely based on the life of rancher Col.

fiddler on the roof.title: Fiddler on the Roof
fiddler on the roof.description: Fiddler on the Roof is a 1971 American epic period musical drama film based on the 1964 stage musical by Joseph Stein, Jerry Bock, and Sheldon Harnick, which itself is based on Tevye and His Daughters by Sholem Aleichem.

the eiger sanction.title: The Eiger Sanction
the eiger sanction.description: The Eiger Sanction is a 1975 American action film directed by and starring Clint Eastwood.

the hi lo country.title: The Hi-Lo Country
the hi lo country.description: The Hi-Lo Country is a 1998 Western film directed by Stephen Frears, starring Billy Crudup, Penélope Cruz, Woody Harrelson, Cole Hauser, Sam Elliott, Patricia Arquette, Enrique Castillo, and Katy Jurado. It is set in post-World War II New Mexico and is based on the Western novel by Max Evans.

the nun.title: The Nun
the nun.description: The Nun (French: La Religieuse; also known as French: Suzanne Simonin, la Religieuse de Denis Diderot) is a 1966 French drama film directed by Jacques Rivette from a screenplay he co-wrote with Jean Gruault, based on the novel of the same title by Denis Diderot.

bullet for stefano.title: Bullet for Stefano
bullet for stefano.description: Bullet for Stefano (Italian: Il Passatore, also known as The Ferryman) is a 1947 Italian adventure-drama-crime film written and directed by Duilio Coletti and starring Rossano Brazzi and Valentina Cortese.

the burning soil.title: The Burning Soil
the burning soil.description: W. Murnau. It was made the same year as Murnau's Nosferatu and released in Germany around the same time. The film follows the struggle over a plot of petroleum-rich land. It was shot at the Babelsberg Studio in Berlin.

the colossus of rhodes.title: The Colossus of Rhodes
the colossus of rhodes.description: The Colossus of Rhodes (Italian: Il Colosso di Rodi) is a 1961 Italian sword and sandal film co-written and directed by Sergio Leone.

the untouchables.title: The Untouchables
the untouchables.description: The Untouchables is a 1987 American crime film directed by Brian De Palma, produced by Art Linson and written by David Mamet. It stars Kevin Costner, Charles Martin Smith, Andy García, Robert De Niro and Sean Connery.

silkwood.title: Silkwood
silkwood.description: Silkwood is a 1983 American biographical drama film directed by Mike Nichols, and starring Meryl Streep, Kurt Russell, and Cher. The screenplay by Nora Ephron and Alice Arlen was adapted from the book Who Killed Karen Silkwood?

a love in germany.title: A Love in Germany
a love in germany.description: Eine Liebe in Deutschland (A Love in Germany) is a 1983 feature film directed by Andrzej Wajda. The film is based on the novel by Rolf Hochhuth about a woman who commits adultery with a prisoner of war while her husband serves as a soldier during World War II.

red sorghum.title: Red Sorghum
red sorghum.description: Red Sorghum is a 1988 Chinese film about a young woman's life working in a distillery for sorghum liquor. It is based on the first two parts of the novel Red Sorghum by Nobel laureate Mo Yan. The film marked the directorial debut of internationally acclaimed filmmaker Zhang Yimou, and the acting debut of film star Gong Li.

l emmerdeur.title: L'emmerdeur
l emmerdeur.description: L'emmerdeur (literally The Troublemaker, with the English title of A Pain in the Ass, often promoted as A Pain in the A__) is a 1973 French-Italian black comedy film, starring Jacques Brel, appearing in his tenth and final feature film.

let sleeping cops lie.title: Let Sleeping Cops Lie
let sleeping cops lie.description: Let Sleeping Cops Lie also known as Don't Wake a Sleeping Cop (French: Ne réveillez pas un flic qui dort) is a French crime film released in 1988, directed by José Pinheiro, starring Alain Delon and Michel Serrault.

epitome.title: Epitome
epitome.description: Epitome (Japanese: 縮図, Hepburn: Shukuzu), also known as Miniature, is a 1953 Japanese drama film written and directed by Kaneto Shindō, based on an unfinished novel by Shūsei Tokuda.

rambo first blood part ii.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
rambo first blood part ii.description: Rambo: First Blood Part II is a 1985 American action film starring Sylvester Stallone as Vietnam War veteran John Rambo. A sequel to First Blood (1982), it is the second installment in the Rambo film series.

a patch of blue.title: A Patch of Blue
a patch of blue.description: A Patch of Blue is a 1965 American drama film directed and written by Guy Green about the friendship between an educated black man (played by Sidney Poitier) and an illiterate, blind, white 18-year-old girl (played by Elizabeth Hartman in her film debut), and the problems that plague their friendship in a racially divided America.

a dangerous toy.title: A Dangerous Toy
a dangerous toy.description: A Dangerous Toy (originally titled Il giocattolo) is a 1979 Italian noir film written and directed by Giuliano Montaldo. It was co-produced by Sergio Leone. The toy of the title is a gun. The film chronicles how a frustrated and shy accountant may become a cruel and ruthless executioner.

panic room.title: Panic Room
panic room.description: Panic Room is a 2002 American thriller film directed by David Fincher. The film stars Jodie Foster and Kristen Stewart as a mother and daughter whose new home is invaded by burglars, played by Forest Whitaker, Jared Leto, and Dwight Yoakam.

woman of rome.title: Woman of Rome
woman of rome.description: Woman of Rome (Italian: La romana) is a 1954 drama film directed by Luigi Zampa, and starring Gina Lollobrigida.

the devil s own.title: The Devil's Own
the devil s own.description: The Devil's Own is a 1997 American action thriller film directed by Alan J. Pakula, starring Harrison Ford and Brad Pitt, with Margaret Colin, Rubén Blades, Treat Williams, and George Hearn in supporting roles.

lucky dragon no 5.title: Lucky Dragon No. 5
lucky dragon no 5.description: Lucky Dragon No. 5 (Japanese: 第五福竜丸, Hepburn: Daigo Fukuryū Maru) is a 1959 Japanese drama film directed by Kaneto Shindō. It is based on events involving the fishing boat Daigo Fukuryū Maru and the Castle Bravo thermonuclear bomb test in 1954.

edo porn.title: Edo Porn
edo porn.description: Edo Porn (Japanese: 北斎漫画, romanized: Hokusai manga) is a 1981 Japanese biographical drama film written and directed by Kaneto Shindō. It is based on Seiichi Yashiro's stage play on the life of Japanese artist Hokusai.

the sucker.title: The Sucker
the sucker.description: The Sucker (French: Le Corniaud, French pronunciation: [lə kɔʁˈnjo]) is a 1965 French, Italian and Spanish comedy film by Gérard Oury starring Louis de Funès, Bourvil and Venantino Venantini. To this day, it remains one of Oury's best-known films.

a day at the beach.title: A Day at the Beach
a day at the beach.description: A Day at the Beach is a 1970 British film directed by Simon Hesera, in his directorial debut, and produced by Gene Gutowski. The film is based on the 1962 book Een dagje naar het strand (translation: A Day at the Beach), by Dutch author Heere Heeresma.

the ghost writer.title: The Ghost Writer
the ghost writer.description: The Ghost Writer (released as The Ghost in the United Kingdom and Ireland) is a 2010 neo-noir political thriller film directed by Roman Polanski. The film is an adaptation of the 2007 novel, The Ghost, by Robert Harris with the screenplay written by Polanski and Harris.

venus in fur.title: Venus in Fur
venus in fur.description: Venus in Fur (French: La Vénus à la fourrure) is a 2013 French-language erotic drama film directed by Roman Polanski, based on the play of the same name by American playwright David Ives, which itself was inspired by Leopold von Sacher-Masoch's novel Venus in Furs.

based on a true story.title: Based on a True Story
based on a true story.description: Based on a True Story (French: D'après une histoire vraie) is a 2017 French-language psychological thriller film directed by Roman Polanski. The screenplay was written by Polanski and Olivier Assayas, adapted from the novel of the same name by Delphine de Vigan.

life of a woman.title: Life of a Woman
life of a woman.description: Life of a Woman (Japanese: 女の一生, Hepburn: Onna no issho) is a 1953 Japanese drama film directed by Kaneto Shindō and starring Nobuko Otowa and Koreya Senda. It was written by Shindō based on Guy de Maupassant's 1883 novel Une vie.

death on the nile.title: Death on the Nile
death on the nile.description: Death on the Nile is a 1978 British mystery film based on Agatha Christie's 1937 novel of the same name, directed by John Guillermin and adapted by Anthony Shaffer.

ulysses.title: Ulysses
ulysses.description: Ulysses (Italian: Ulisse) is a 1954 fantasy adventure film based on Homer's epic poem Odyssey. The film is directed by Mario Camerini, who co-wrote the screenplay with writer Franco Brusati, and produced by Dino De Laurentiis and Carlo Ponti.

the cowboys.title: The Cowboys
the cowboys.description: The Cowboys is a 1972 American Western film starring John Wayne, Roscoe Lee Browne, and Bruce Dern, and featuring Colleen Dewhurst and Slim Pickens. It was the feature film debut of Robert Carradine., and Jennings and was directed by Mark Rydell.

the triangle.title: The Triangle
the triangle.description: The Triangle is a 2001 thriller television movie directed by Lewis Teague and starring Luke Perry and Dan Cortese. Released on August 13, 2001, it was filmed in Barbados and Canada.

7 faces of dr lao.title: 7 Faces of Dr. Lao
7 faces of dr lao.description: 7 Faces of Dr. Lao is a 1964 American Metrocolor Western fantasy-comedy film directed by George Pal (his final directorial effort) and starring Tony Randall. The film, an adaptation by screenwriters Charles Beaumont and Ben Hecht of Charles G.

the lady of monza.title: The Lady of Monza
the lady of monza.description: The Lady of Monza (Italian: La monaca di Monza, also known as The Awful Story of the Nun of Monza and The Nun of Monza) is a 1969 Italian historical drama film directed by Eriprando Visconti.

sonny and jed.title: Sonny and Jed
sonny and jed.description: Sonny and Jed (Italian: La banda J. & S. - Cronaca criminale del Far-West, lit. "The J. & S.

how do you know.title: How Do You Know
how do you know.description: How Do You Know is a 2010 American romantic comedy film directed, written and produced by James L. Brooks, and starring Reese Witherspoon, Owen Wilson, Paul Rudd and Jack Nicholson in his final appearance before his retirement.

the boy from oklahoma.title: The Boy from Oklahoma
the boy from oklahoma.description: , Nancy Olson and Anthony Caruso. It was produced and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

thunderheart.title: Thunderheart
thunderheart.description: Thunderheart is a 1992 American Neo-Western mystery film directed by Michael Apted from a screenplay by John Fusco.

house of sand and fog.title: House of Sand and Fog
house of sand and fog.description: House of Sand and Fog is a 2003 drama film directed by Vadim Perelman, with a screenplay written by Perelman and Shawn Lawrence Otto. It is based on the novel of the same name by Andre Dubus III.

villain.title: Villain
villain.description: Villain (Japanese: 悪人, Hepburn: Akunin) is a 2010 Japanese drama film directed by Sang-il Lee, based on Shuichi Yoshida's crime noir novel of the same name.

the killing of a sacred deer.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
the killing of a sacred deer.wikipedia: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
the killing of a sacred deer.description: The Killing of a Sacred Deer is a 2017 absurdist psychological horror thriller film directed and co-produced by Yorgos Lanthimos, who also co-wrote the screenplay with Efthimis Filippou. It stars Colin Farrell, Nicole Kidman, Barry Keoghan, Raffey Cassidy, Sunny Suljic, Alicia Silverstone, and Bill Camp.

edge of darkness.title: Edge of Darkness
edge of darkness.description: Edge of Darkness is a 2010 crime thriller film directed by Martin Campbell, written by William Monahan and Andrew Bovell, and starring Mel Gibson and Ray Winstone. A British-American co-production, it is based on the 1985 BBC television series of the same name, which was likewise directed by Campbell.

the great dictator.title: The Great Dictator
the great dictator.description: The Great Dictator is a 1940 American political satire black comedy film written, directed, produced by, and starring Charlie Chaplin. Having been the only major Hollywood filmmaker to continue to make silent films well into the period of sound films, Chaplin made this his first true sound film.

xiao wu.title: Xiao Wu
xiao wu.description: Xiao Wu (Chinese: 小武), also known as Pickpocket, is a 1998 Chinese drama and the first directed by Jia Zhangke. Starring Wang Hongwei in the title role along with Hao Hongjian and Zuo Baitao, it was filmed in Fenyang, Jia's hometown, in 16 mm.

tokyo.title: Tokyo!
tokyo.description: Tokyo! is a 2008 comedy-drama anthology film containing three segments written by three non-Japanese directors and filmed in Tokyo, Japan.

the best of enemies.title: The Best of Enemies
the best of enemies.description: The Best of Enemies (I due nemici) is a 1961 Italian film directed by Guy Hamilton and Alessandro Blasetti set during the World War II East African Campaign, but filmed in Israel. It stars David Niven, Alberto Sordi and Michael Wilding.

john goldfarb please come home.title: John Goldfarb, Please Come Home!
john goldfarb please come home.description: John Goldfarb, Please Come Home! is a 1965 American comedy film based on the novel by William Peter Blatty published in 1963. The film was directed by J. Lee Thompson. The film was shot in the Mojave Desert.

the patriot.title: The Patriot
the patriot.description: The Patriot is a 2000 American epic historical war film directed by Roland Emmerich and written by Robert Rodat. The film stars Mel Gibson, Heath Ledger, Joely Richardson, Jason Isaacs, Chris Cooper, and Tom Wilkinson.

my friends.title: My Friends
my friends.description: My Friends (Italian: Amici miei) is a 1975 Italian comedy film directed by Mario Monicelli. The film project belonged to Pietro Germi, who had no chance to make it happen because of his untimely death.

circle of deceit.title: Circle of Deceit
circle of deceit.description: Circle of Deceit (German title: Die Fälschung, 'the deception'; French title: Le Faussaire) is an anti-war film directed by Volker Schlöndorff and internationally released in 1981. An international co-production, it was an adaptation of Nicolas Born's novel The Deception, which had appeared in 1979.

the glass mountain.title: The Glass Mountain
the glass mountain.description: The Glass Mountain is a 1949 black and white British romantic film drama directed by Henry Cass. It starred Michael Denison, Dulcie Gray and Valentina Cortese. The film was a popular success of its day, and was re-released in the UK in 1950 and 1953.

tragedy of a ridiculous man.title: Tragedy of a Ridiculous Man
tragedy of a ridiculous man.description: Tragedy of a Ridiculous Man (Italian: La tragedia di un uomo ridicolo) is a 1981 Italian film directed by Bernardo Bertolucci. It stars Anouk Aimée and Ugo Tognazzi, who was awarded the Best Male Actor Award at the 1981 Cannes Film Festival for his performance.

bay of angels.title: Bay of Angels
bay of angels.description: Bay of Angels (French: La baie des anges) is a 1963 French romantic drama film written and directed by Jacques Demy. Starring Jeanne Moreau and Claude Mann, it is Demy's second film and deals with the subject of gambling.

it happened in the park.title: It Happened in the Park
it happened in the park.description: It Happened in the Park (Italian: Villa Borghese) is a 1953 film directed by Gianni Franciolini. The film consists of six vignettes set in the Villa Borghese gardens in Rome.

location hunting in palestine.title: Location Hunting in Palestine
location hunting in palestine.description: Location Hunting in Palestine or Sopralluoghi in Palestina per il vangelo secondo Matteo is a 1965 Italian documentary film directed by Pier Paolo Pasolini. Disappointed by the overly modern landscapes, Pasolini abandoned the idea of filming on the very sites where Christ lived.

raiders of the lost ark the adaptation.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark: The Adaptation
raiders of the lost ark the adaptation.wikipedia: Raiders of the Lost Ark: The Adaptation
raiders of the lost ark the adaptation.description: Raiders of the Lost Ark: The Adaptation is a 1989 American fan film, made as a shot-for-shot remake of the 1981 Indiana Jones adventure film Raiders of the Lost Ark.

on dangerous ground.title: On Dangerous Ground
on dangerous ground.description: On Dangerous Ground is a 1951 film noir directed by Nicholas Ray, produced by John Houseman, and starring Robert Ryan and Ida Lupino. The screenplay was written by A. I. Bezzerides based on the 1945 novel Mad with Much Heart by Gerald Butler.

the outlaw.title: The Outlaw
the outlaw.description: The Outlaw is a 1943 American Western film directed by Howard Hughes and starring Jack Buetel, Jane Russell, Thomas Mitchell and Walter Huston. Hughes produced the film, replacing original director Howard Hawks with himself, and replacing original cinematographer Lucien Ballard with Gregg Toland.

the savage innocents.title: The Savage Innocents
the savage innocents.description: The Savage Innocents is a 1960 adventure film directed and co-written by Nicholas Ray. Anthony Quinn and Yoko Tani star, with Lee Montague, Marco Guglielmi, Carlo Giustini, Anthony Chinn, and Michael Chow in supporting roles, alongside Peter O' Toole in an early film role.

life and nothing more.title: Life, and Nothing More...
life and nothing more.description: ) is a 1992 Iranian film directed by Abbas Kiarostami. It was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1992 Cannes Film Festival. It is the second film in Kiarostami's so-called Koker trilogy.; this film is a semi-fictional work based on that search.

working girl.title: Working Girl
working girl.description: Working Girl is a 1988 American romantic comedy drama film directed by Mike Nichols, written by Kevin Wade, and starring Harrison Ford, Sigourney Weaver, and Melanie Griffith. Its plot follows an ambitious secretary from Staten Island working in mergers and acquisitions.

ningen.title: Ningen
ningen.description: Ningen (人間), also titled Human, is a 1962 Japanese drama film written and directed by Kaneto Shindō. It is based on the novel Kaijin maru (海神丸) by Yaeko Nogami.

akuto film.title: Akuto (Film)
akuto film.description: Akuto (Japanese: 悪党, Hepburn: Akutō; lit. "Villain"), released in the United States as Conquest, is a 1965 Japanese jidaigeki and drama film written and directed by Kaneto Shindō. It is based on the play Kaoyo by Jun'ichirō Tanizaki.

tree without leaves.title: Tree Without Leaves
tree without leaves.description: Tree Without Leaves (落葉樹, Rakuyōju; lit. "Deciduous Tree") is a 1986 Japanese autobiographical drama film written and directed by Kaneto Shindō.

daddy s gone a hunting.title: Daddy's Gone A-Hunting
daddy s gone a hunting.description: Daddy's Gone A-Hunting is a 1969 American thriller film directed by Mark Robson and starring Carol White, Paul Burke, and Scott Hylands. Its title comes from the lullaby "Bye, baby Bunting". A novelization of the film was released in the same year.

the man who loved cat dancing.title: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing
the man who loved cat dancing.wikipedia: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing (film)
the man who loved cat dancing.description: The Man Who Loved Cat Dancing is a 1973 American Western film adaptation of Marilyn Durham's novel of the same name directed by Richard C. Sarafian, written by Eleanor Perry and William W. Norton, and starring Burt Reynolds and Sarah Miles.

the lady gambles.title: The Lady Gambles
the lady gambles.description: The Lady Gambles is a 1949 American film noir drama film directed by Michael Gordon and starring Barbara Stanwyck, Robert Preston and Stephen McNally.

white sister.title: White Sister
white sister.description: , lit.', also known as The Sin) is a 1972 Italian comedy film directed by Alberto Lattuada. The film was a commercial success.

what am i doing in the middle of the rev.title: What Am I Doing in the Middle of the Revolution?
what am i doing in the middle of the rev.wikipedia: What Am I Doing in the Middle of a Revolution?
what am i doing in the middle of the rev.description: What Am I Doing in the Middle of a Revolution?) is a 1972 Zapata Western comedy film.". It is the final chapter of the Corbucci's trilogy about the Mexican revolution, after The Mercenary and Compañeros. The film mixes comedy and political apologue.

exorcist ii the heretic.title: Exorcist II: The Heretic
exorcist ii the heretic.description: Exorcist II: The Heretic is a 1977 American supernatural science fiction horror film directed by John Boorman and written by William Goodhart.

monsignor.title: Monsignor
monsignor.description: Monsignor is a 1982 American drama film directed by Frank Perry about Roman Catholic priest John Flaherty's rise through the ranks of the Vatican, during and after World War II.

far and away.title: Far and Away
far and away.description: Far and Away is a 1992 American epic Western romantic adventure drama film directed by Ron Howard from a screenplay by Bob Dolman and a story by Howard and Dolman. It stars Tom Cruise and Nicole Kidman. This was the last cinematography credit for Mikael Salomon before he moved on to a directing career.

nixon.title: Nixon
nixon.description: Nixon is a 1995 American epic historical drama film directed by Oliver Stone, produced by Stone, Clayton Townsend, and Andrew G. Vajna, and written by Stone, Christopher Wilkinson, and Stephen J. Rivele.S.

a big bold beautiful journey.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
a big bold beautiful journey.description: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey is a 2025 American romantic fantasy film directed by Kogonada and written by Seth Reiss. The film stars Margot Robbie, Colin Farrell, Kevin Kline, and Phoebe Waller-Bridge.

yamato.title: Yamato
yamato.description: Yamato (Japanese: 男たちの大和, Hepburn: Otoko-tachi no Yamato; lit. "The Men's Yamato") is a 2005 Japanese war film. It was directed by Junya Satō and is based on a book by Jun Henmi.

a hatful of rain.title: A Hatful of Rain
a hatful of rain.description: A Hatful of Rain is a 1957 American drama film directed by Fred Zinnemann and starring Eva Marie Saint, Don Murray, Anthony Franciosa and Lloyd Nolan. It is adapted by Michael V. Gazzo, Alfred Hayes, and Carl Foreman from Gazzo's 1955 play.

liza.title: Liza
liza.description: Liza (Italian: La cagna, lit. 'The Bitch') is a 1972 Italian drama film directed by Marco Ferreri. It is based on the short story "Melampus" by Ennio Flaiano.

the fossil.title: The Fossil
the fossil.description: The Fossil (Japanese: 化石, Hepburn: Kaseki) is a Japanese TV miniseries which screened in eight parts between 31 January and 20 March 1972. It was directed by Masaki Kobayashi and based on a novel by Yasushi Inoue.

11 09 01 september 11.title: 11'09"01 September 11
11 09 01 september 11.description: 11′09″01 September 11 (French: 11 minutes 9 secondes 1 image) is a 2002 international anthology film. It comprises 11 short films from 11 filmmakers, each from a different country, offering differing perspectives on the 9/11 terrorist attacks on the Twin Towers in New York City in 2001.

oh rosalinda.title: Oh... Rosalinda!!
oh rosalinda.description: Oh... Rosalinda!! (also known as Die Fledermaus ) is a 1955 British musical comedy film by the British director-writer team of Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger. The film stars Michael Redgrave, Mel Ferrer, Anthony Quayle, Ludmilla Tchérina and Anton Walbrook and features Anneliese Rothenberger and Dennis Price.

t2 3d battle across time.title: T2-3D: Battle Across Time
t2 3d battle across time.description: T2-3D: Battle Across Time (also known as Terminator 2: 3D or Terminator 2 3-D: Battle Across Time) was an attraction at Universal Studios Florida, Universal Studios Hollywood and Universal Studios Japan. The version of the show in Hollywood had its final performance on December 31, 2012; the show then closed January 1, 2013.

adua and her friends.title: Adua and Her Friends
adua and her friends.description: Adua and Her Friends (Italian: Adua e le compagne), also known as Hungry For Love, is a 1960 Italian film directed by Antonio Pietrangeli with a collaborative screenplay by the film's director together with Ruggero Maccari, Ettore Scola and Tullio Pinelli.

no direction home.title: No Direction Home
no direction home.description: No Direction Home: Bob Dylan is a 2005 documentary film directed by Martin Scorsese that traces the life of Bob Dylan, and his impact on 20th-century American popular music and culture.

stavisky.title: Stavisky
stavisky.description: Stavisky... is a 1974 French biographical drama film based on the life of the financier and embezzler Alexandre Stavisky and the circumstances leading to his mysterious death in 1934.

hollow man.title: Hollow Man
hollow man.description: Hollow Man is a 2000 science fiction horror film directed by Paul Verhoeven and written by Andrew W. Marlowe from a story he co-wrote with Gary Scott Thompson. The film stars Elisabeth Shue, Kevin Bacon, Josh Brolin, Kim Dickens, Greg Grunberg, Joey Slotnick, Mary Randle, and William Devane.

where is freedom.title: Where Is Freedom?
where is freedom.description: Where Is Freedom?) is a 1954 Italian comedy-drama film directed by Roberto Rossellini. The film had a troubled production because, after shooting some scenes, Rossellini lost interest in the film and abandoned the set.

55 days at peking.title: 55 Days at Peking
55 days at peking.description: 55 Days at Peking is a 1963 American epic historical war film dramatizing the siege of the foreign legations' compounds in Beijing (then known in English as Peking) during the Boxer Rebellion, which took place in China in the summer of 1900.

liliom.title: Liliom
liliom.description: Liliom is a 1934 French fantasy film directed by Fritz Lang based on the 1909 Hungarian stage play of the same title by Ferenc Molnár. The film stars Charles Boyer as Liliom, a carousel barker who is fired from his job after defending the chambermaid Julie (Madeleine Ozeray) from the jealousy of Mme.

the syndicate a death in the family.title: The Syndicate: A Death in the Family
the syndicate a death in the family.wikipedia: The Syndicate: A Death in the Family
the syndicate a death in the family.description: The Syndicate: A Death in the Family (Italian: Colpo rovente, also known as Red Hot Shot) is a 1970 Italian crime film directed by Piero Zuffi and written by Ennio Flaiano and the same Zuffi.

carol.title: Carol
carol.description: Carol is a 2015 historical romantic drama film directed by Todd Haynes. The screenplay by Phyllis Nagy is based on the 1952 romance novel The Price of Salt by Patricia Highsmith (republished as Carol in 1990).

the seafarers.title: The Seafarers
the seafarers.description: The Seafarers is a documentary short film directed by Stanley Kubrick, made for the Seafarers International Union, directed in June 1953. The film was Kubrick's first in color.

the young one.title: The Young One
the young one.description: The Young One (Spanish: La joven) (released as White Trash in the United States and Island of Shame in the United Kingdom) is a 1960 English-language Mexican drama film directed and co-written by Luis Buñuel, and starring Zachary Scott, Bernie Hamilton, Key Meersman, Crahan Denton and Claudio Brook.

boxcar bertha.title: Boxcar Bertha
boxcar bertha.description: Boxcar Bertha is a 1972 American romantic crime drama film directed by Martin Scorsese and produced by Roger Corman, from a screenplay by Joyce H. Corrington and John William Corrington. Made on a low budget, the film is a loose adaptation of Sister of the Road, a pseudo-autobiographical account of the fictional character Bertha Thompson.

death for five voices.title: Death for Five Voices
death for five voices.description: Gesualdo: Death for Five Voices (German: Tod für fünf Stimmen) is a 1995 film by German director Werner Herzog filmed for ZDF television. The film explores the music of Carlo Gesualdo and the legends surrounding Gesualdo's personality, his cursed castle, and his murder of his wife and her lover.

the southern star.title: The Southern Star
the southern star.description: The Southern Star (French title: L'Étoile du sud) is a 1969 adventure comedy film directed by Sidney Hayers and starring George Segal, Ursula Andress, Orson Welles, Ian Hendry and Johnny Sekka. In French West Africa in 1912, an extremely valuable diamond is stolen.

the birth of love.title: The Birth of Love
the birth of love.description: The Birth of Love (French: La Naissance de l'amour) is a 1993 drama film directed by Philippe Garrel. Garrel also wrote the screenplay together with his long-time collaborators Muriel Cerf and Marc Cholodenko.

children of hiroshima.title: Children of Hiroshima
children of hiroshima.description: Children of Hiroshima (Japanese: 原爆の子, Hepburn: Genbaku no ko; lit. "Children of the Atomic Bomb") is a 1952 Japanese drama film directed by Kaneto Shindō and starring Nobuko Otowa. It was written by Shindō based on the 1951 book Children of the Atomic Bomb by Arata Osada.

air force one.title: Air Force One
air force one.description: Air Force One is a 1997 American political action thriller film directed and co-produced by Wolfgang Petersen and written by Andrew W. Marlowe. Starring Harrison Ford, Gary Oldman, Glenn Close, Wendy Crewson, Xander Berkeley, William H.

up the macgregors.title: Up the MacGregors!
up the macgregors.description: Up the MacGregors! (Italian: 7 donne per i MacGregor, also known as 7 Women for the MacGregors) is a 1967 Italian spaghetti Western Technicolor film in Techniscope directed by Franco Giraldi (credited as Frank Garfield).

teorema.title: Teorema
teorema.description: Teorema (English: "Theorem") is a 1968 Italian allegorical art film written and directed by Pier Paolo Pasolini. The film centers on an upper-class Milanese family who are introduced to, and then abandoned by, an otherworldly man with a mysterious divine force.

metello.title: Metello
metello.description: Metello is a 1970 Italian drama film directed by Mauro Bolognini. It was entered into the 1970 Cannes Film Festival. It starred Massimo Ranieri as the title character.

postcards from the edge.title: Postcards from the Edge
postcards from the edge.description: Postcards from the Edge is a 1990 American comedy drama film directed by Mike Nichols. The screenplay by Carrie Fisher is based on her 1987 semi-autobiographical novel. The film stars Meryl Streep, Shirley MacLaine, and Dennis Quaid.

the fireworks wednesday.title: The Fireworks Wednesday
the fireworks wednesday.description: Fireworks Wednesday (Persian: چهارشنبه‌سوری, romanized: Čahâršanbe-Suri) is a 2006 Iranian drama film directed by Asghar Farhadi and co-written by Farhadi and Mani Haghighi. It stars Hedieh Tehrani, Taraneh Alidoosti, and Hamid Farokhnezhad.

destinees.title: Destinées
destinees.description: Daughters of Destiny (UK title: Love, Soldiers and Women, French title: Destinées and Italian title: Destini di donne) is a 1954 Franco-Italian co-production motion picture comedy drama directed by Marcello Pagliero, Jean Delannoy and Christian-Jaque.

comandamenti per un gangster.title: Comandamenti per un gangster
comandamenti per un gangster.description: Comandamenti per un gangster (Commandments for a Gangster) is a 1968 gangster film directed by Alfio Caltabiano

the return of a man called horse.title: The Return of a Man Called Horse
the return of a man called horse.wikipedia: The Return of a Man Called Horse
the return of a man called horse.description: The Return of a Man Called Horse is a 1976 Western film directed by Irvin Kershner and written by Jack DeWitt. It is a sequel to the 1970 film A Man Called Horse, in turn based on Dorothy M.

madame x.title: Madame X
madame x.description: Madame X is a 1966 American suspense drama film directed by David Lowell Rich and starring Lana Turner, John Forsythe, Ricardo Montalbán, Burgess Meredith, Constance Bennett, and Keir Dullea.

more than a miracle.title: More Than a Miracle
more than a miracle.description: More Than a Miracle (Italian: C'era una volta) is a 1967 film also titled Cinderella Italian Style and Happily Ever After. It stars Sophia Loren, Omar Sharif and Dolores del Río. The movie has a fairy tale narrative.

peggy sue got married.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
peggy sue got married.description: Peggy Sue Got Married is a 1986 American fantasy comedy-drama film directed by Francis Ford Coppola starring Kathleen Turner as a woman on the verge of a divorce, who finds herself transported back to the days of her senior year in high school in 1960.

how to steal a million.title: How to Steal a Million
how to steal a million.description: How to Steal a Million is a 1966 American heist comedy film directed by William Wyler and starring Audrey Hepburn, Peter O'Toole, Eli Wallach, Hugh Griffith, and Charles Boyer. The film is set and was filmed in Paris, though the characters speak entirely in English.

penelope.title: Penelope
penelope.description: Penelope is a 1966 American comedy caper film directed by Arthur Hiller, and starring Natalie Wood, Ian Bannen, Peter Falk, Jonathan Winters, and Dick Shawn.V. Cunningham.

the betrayal.title: The Betrayal
the betrayal.description: Fräulein Doktor is a 1969 spy film loosely based on the life of Elsbeth Schragmüller. It was an Italian and Yugoslavian co-production directed by Alberto Lattuada, starring Suzy Kendall and Kenneth More, and featuring Capucine, James Booth, Giancarlo Giannini and Nigel Green.

pete n tillie.title: Pete 'n' Tillie
pete n tillie.description: Pete 'n' Tillie is a 1972 American comedy-drama film directed by Martin Ritt and starring Walter Matthau and Carol Burnett. Its advertising tagline was: "Honeymoon's over." At the 45th Academy Awards, screenwriter Julius J.

stepmom.title: Stepmom
stepmom.description: Stepmom is a 1998 American comedy-drama film directed by Chris Columbus and produced by Wendy Finerman, Mark Radcliffe, and Michael Barnathan. The screenplay was written by Gigi Levangie, Jessie Nelson, Steven Rogers, Karen Leigh Hopkins, and Ron Bass.

harry potter and the philosopher s stone.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
harry potter and the philosopher s stone.wikipedia: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (film)
harry potter and the philosopher s stone.description: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (also known as Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone in the United States, India and the Philippines) is a 2001 fantasy film directed by Chris Columbus and written by Steve Kloves, based on the 1997 novel by J.

fury.title: Fury
fury.description: Fury is a 1936 American crime film directed by Fritz Lang that tells the story of an innocent man (Spencer Tracy) who narrowly escapes being burned to death by a lynch mob and the revenge he then seeks. It was Lang's first American film.

midway.title: Midway
midway.description: Midway (released in the United Kingdom as Battle of Midway) is a 1976 American war film that chronicles the Battle of Midway, a turning point in the Pacific War of World War II. It is directed by Jack Smight and produced by Walter Mirisch, from a screenplay by Donald S.

gli indifferenti.title: Gli indifferenti
gli indifferenti.description: Time of Indifference (Italian: Gli indifferenti, lit. 'The indifferent ones') is a 1964 Italian–French drama film directed by Francesco Maselli starring Claudia Cardinale. It is based on the novel Gli indifferenti by Alberto Moravia.

italianamerican.title: Italianamerican
italianamerican.description: Italianamerican is a 1974 American documentary film directed by Martin Scorsese and featuring his parents Catherine and Charles, who reflect on their experiences as the children of Italian immigrants to New York City.

the shortest day.title: The Shortest Day
the shortest day.description: The Shortest Day (Italian: Il giorno più corto) is a 1963 Italian comedy film. It is a parody of the war movie The Longest Day and stars the popular duo Franco and Ciccio in the leading roles.

zatoichi and the chest of gold.title: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
zatoichi and the chest of gold.wikipedia: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
zatoichi and the chest of gold.description: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold (座頭市千両首, Zatōichi senryō-kubi) is a 1964 Japanese Chambara film directed by Kazuo Ikehiro starring Shintaro Katsu as the blind masseur Zatoichi, originally released by the Daiei Motion Picture Company (later acquired by Kadokawa Pictures).

the sunday woman.title: The Sunday Woman
the sunday woman.description: The Sunday Woman (Italian: La donna della domenica) is a 1975 Italian crime film directed by Luigi Comencini. It is based upon the novel of the same name by Carlo Fruttero and Franco Lucentini.

it takes two.title: It Takes Two
it takes two.description: It Takes Two is a 1988 American romantic comedy film directed by David Beaird and starring George Newbern, Leslie Hope, and Kimberly Foster. Screenwriters Richard Christian Matheson and Thomas E. Szollosi had previously collaborated on the 1987 teen comedy Three O'Clock High.

doc hollywood.title: Doc Hollywood
doc hollywood.description: Doc Hollywood is a 1991 American romantic comedy film directed by Michael Caton-Jones and written by Daniel Pyne along with Jeffrey Price and Peter S. Seaman, based on Neil B. Shulman's book What?Again? The film stars Michael J.

mystery alaska.title: Mystery, Alaska
mystery alaska.description: Mystery, Alaska is a 1999 American sports comedy-drama film, directed by Jay Roach, about an amateur ice hockey team from the fictional small town of Mystery that plays an exhibition game against the National Hockey League (NHL)'s New York Rangers.

adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptation.description: ) is a 2002 American metafictional comedy-drama film directed by Spike Jonze and written by Charlie Kaufman. It features a cast led by Nicolas Cage, Meryl Streep, and Chris Cooper, with Tilda Swinton, Cara Seymour, Brian Cox, Maggie Gyllenhaal, and Ron Livingston in supporting roles.

matchstick men.title: Matchstick Men
matchstick men.description: Matchstick Men is a 2003 American black comedy crime film directed by Ridley Scott and based on Eric Garcia's 2002 novel of the same name. The film stars Nicolas Cage, Sam Rockwell, and Alison Lohman. The film premiered on September 2, 2003, at the 60th Venice International Film Festival and was released by Warner Bros.

wonderstruck.title: Wonderstruck
wonderstruck.description: Wonderstruck is a 2017 American mystery drama film directed by Todd Haynes, based on the 2011 novel Wonderstruck by Brian Selznick, who adapted the novel into the screenplay. The film stars Oakes Fegley, Julianne Moore, Michelle Williams, and Millicent Simmonds in her film debut.

il gatto.title: Il gatto
il gatto.description: ) is a 1977 Italian giallo-comedy film directed by Luigi Comencini. For this film, Mariangela Melato was awarded with a David di Donatello for Best Actress.

firelight.title: Firelight
firelight.description: Firelight is a 1964 science fiction film written and directed by American filmmaker Steven Spielberg at the age of 17. This is Spielberg's feature film directorial debut.

six men getting sick.title: Six Men Getting Sick
six men getting sick.description: Six Men Getting Sick (Six Times) (sometimes known as Six Figures Getting Sick) is a 1967 experimental animated short film, directed by David Lynch.

autumn almanac.title: Autumn Almanac
autumn almanac.description: Almanac of Fall (Hungarian: Őszi almanach) is a 1984 Hungarian film directed by Béla Tarr and edited by his directorial collaborator Ágnes Hranitzky. The Curzon Artificial Eye edition of this film available in the UK is called Autumn Almanac.

the innocent.title: The Innocent
the innocent.description: The Innocent is a 1985 John Mackenzie drama film, starring Andrew Hawley, Liam Neeson and Miranda Richardson, and is set in the Yorkshire Dales just after World War I.

with beauty and sorrow.title: With Beauty and Sorrow
with beauty and sorrow.description: With Beauty and Sorrow (Japanese: 美しさと哀しみと, Hepburn: Utsukushisa to kanashimi to; lit. Beauty and Sorrow) is a 1965 Japanese drama film directed by Masahiro Shinoda. It is based on the novel Beauty and Sadness (1961–63) by Nobel Prize winning writer Yasunari Kawabata.

gli ordini sono ordini.title: Gli ordini sono ordini
gli ordini sono ordini.description: Gli ordini sono ordini ("Orders Are Orders") is a 1972 Italian comedy film directed by Franco Giraldi.

comes a horseman.title: Comes a Horseman
comes a horseman.description: Comes a Horseman is a 1978 American Western drama film starring James Caan, Jane Fonda, Jason Robards, and Richard Farnsworth, directed by Alan J. Pakula." Ewing (Robards).

two evil eyes.title: Two Evil Eyes
two evil eyes.description: Two Evil Eyes (Italian: Due occhi diabolici) is a 1990 anthology horror film written and directed by George A. Romero and Dario Argento. An international co-production of Italy and the United States, Two Evil Eyes is split into two separate tales, both based largely on the works of Edgar Allan Poe: "The Facts in the Case of M.

ramuntcho.title: Ramuntcho
ramuntcho.description: Ramuntcho is a 1959 French drama film directed by Pierre Schoendoerffer and starring François Guérin, Mijanou Bardot and Gaby Morlay. It is based on Pierre Loti's 1897 novel of the same title.

great expectations.title: Great Expectations
great expectations.description: Great Expectations is a 1998 American romantic drama film directed by Alfonso Cuarón and written by Mitch Glazer. It stars Ethan Hawke, Gwyneth Paltrow, Hank Azaria, Chris Cooper, Anne Bancroft and Robert De Niro.

professor my son.title: Professor, My son
professor my son.description: Professor, My Son (Italian: Mio figlio professore, also known as My Son, the Professor) is a 1946 Italian comedy-drama film written and directed by Renato Castellani.

in ginocchio da te.title: In ginocchio da te
in ginocchio da te.description: In ginocchio da te (lit. 'On my knees before you') is a 1964 Italian musicarello film directed by Ettore Maria Fizzarotti and starring Gianni Morandi. It is based on the Morandi's song with the same title.

non son degno di te.title: Non son degno di te
non son degno di te.description: Non son degno di te is a 1965 Italian musicarello romance film directed by Ettore Maria Fizzarotti.

se non avessi piu te.title: Se non avessi più te
se non avessi piu te.description: Se non avessi più te is a 1965 Italian musicarello romantic comedy film directed by Ettore Maria Fizzarotti.

arabian nights.title: Arabian Nights
arabian nights.description: Arabian Nights (Italian: Il fiore delle Mille e una notte, lit. 'The Flower of the One Thousand and One Nights') is a 1974 erotic fantasy comedy anthology film directed by Pier Paolo Pasolini. The film is an adaptation of the ancient Arabic anthology One Thousand and One Nights, also known as The Arabian Nights.

whistle stop.title: Whistle Stop
whistle stop.description: Whistle Stop is a 1946 American film noir crime film directed by Léonide Moguy and starring George Raft, Ava Gardner, Victor McLaglen, and Tom Conway. It was produced by Seymour Nebenzal's Nero Films and distributed by United Artists.

the vagabond king.title: The Vagabond King
the vagabond king.description: The Vagabond King is a 1956 American musical film directed by Michael Curtiz and starring Kathryn Grayson, Rita Moreno, Sir Cedric Hardwicke, Walter Hampden, Leslie Nielsen, and Maltese singer Oreste Kirkop in his only feature film role.

but not for me.title: But Not for Me
but not for me.description: But Not for Me is a 1959 American comedy film directed by Walter Lang and starring Clark Gable, Carroll Baker and Lilli Palmer. It was distributed by Paramount Pictures. It is based on the 1934 play Accent on Youth written by Samson Raphaelson.

the music man.title: The Music Man
the music man.description: The Music Man is a 1962 American musical film directed and produced by Morton DaCosta, based on Meredith Willson's 1957 Broadway musical of the same name, which DaCosta also directed.

jarhead.title: Jarhead
jarhead.description: Jarhead is a 2005 biographical war drama film based on the 2003 memoir of the same name by Anthony Swofford, chronicling his military service in the United States Marine Corps during the Persian Gulf War. Directed by Sam Mendes, the film stars Jake Gyllenhaal as Swofford with Jamie Foxx, Peter Sarsgaard, Lucas Black, and Chris Cooper.

classe tous risques.title: Classe tous risques
classe tous risques.description: Classe tous risques ([klas tu ʁisk]; literally "All-Risk Class", but also a pun on the French expression "Classe Touriste", Economy Class), which was first released in the United States as The Big Risk, is a 1960 French-Italian gangster film directed by Claude Sautet and starring Lino Ventura, Jean-Paul Belmondo and Sandra Milo.

the great war.title: The Great War
the great war.description: The Great War (Italian: La grande guerra) is a 1959 Italian comedy-drama war film directed by Mario Monicelli. It tells the story of an odd couple of army buddies in World War I; the movie, while played on a comedic register, does not hide from the viewer the horrors and grimness of trench warfare.

melinda and melinda.title: Melinda and Melinda
melinda and melinda.description: Melinda and Melinda is a 2004 American comedy-drama film written and directed by Woody Allen. The film is set in Manhattan and stars Radha Mitchell as the protagonist Melinda, in two storylines; one tragic and the other comic.

gardens of stone.title: Gardens of Stone
gardens of stone.description: Gardens of Stone is a 1987 American drama film directed by Francis Ford Coppola, based on a 1983 novel of the same name by Nicholas Proffitt. It stars James Caan, Anjelica Huston, James Earl Jones, D. B. Sweeney, Dean Stockwell and Mary Stuart Masterson.

tormented.title: Tormented
tormented.description: Tormented (ラビット・ホラー３Ｄ, rabitto horā 3D) is a 2011 Japanese horror film directed by Takashi Shimizu. The film involves Kiriko (Hikari Mitsushima) and her younger half-brother Daigo (Takeru Shibuya) who are haunted by a large rabbit-doll.

not with my wife you don t.title: Not with My Wife, You Don't!
not with my wife you don t.wikipedia: Not with My Wife, You Don't!
not with my wife you don t.description: Not with My Wife, You Don't!) is a 1966 American comedy film starring Tony Curtis, Virna Lisi and George C. Scott. The film was nominated for a Golden Globe for Best Motion Picture – Musical/Comedy.

spacecamp.title: SpaceCamp
spacecamp.description: S. Space Camp in Huntsville, Alabama. Directed by Harry Winer, story by Patrick Bailey and Larry B. Williams, screenplay by Clifford Green (as W. W. Wicket) and Casey T. Mitchell, the film stars Kate Capshaw, Kelly Preston, Larry B.

sacco and vanzetti.title: Sacco and Vanzetti
sacco and vanzetti.description: Sacco & Vanzetti (Italian: Sacco e Vanzetti) is a 1971 historical legal drama film, based on the trial of Italian-American anarchists Nicola Sacco and Bartolomeo Vanzetti, whose guilty verdict and execution was considered a politically-motivated miscarriage of justice.

the long silence.title: The Long Silence
the long silence.description: The Long Silence (Italian: Il lungo silenzio, German: Zeit des Zorns, French: Le long silence) is a 1993 Italian-German-French political thriller film directed by Margarethe von Trotta.

welcome to dongmakgol.title: Welcome to Dongmakgol
welcome to dongmakgol.description: Welcome to Dongmakgol (Korean: 웰컴 투 동막골), also known as Battle Ground 625 (UK), is a 2005 South Korean war comedy-drama film. Based on the same-titled long-running stage play by filmmaker/playwright Jang Jin, Park Kwang-hyun's debut film was a commercial and critical success.

i delfini.title: I Delfini
i delfini.description: Silver Spoon Set (Italian: I Delfini, lit. 'The Dolphins') is a 1960 Italian–French drama film directed by Francesco Maselli. It features an ensemble cast including Claudia Cardinale, Tomas Milian, Betsy Blair and Gérard Blain.

drama of the rich.title: Drama of the Rich
drama of the rich.description: The Murri Affair (Italian: Fatti di gente perbene, lit. 'Facts of Decent People'; French: La grande bourgeoise, lit. 'The Great Bourgeois') is a 1974 historical drama film directed by Mauro Bolognini, starring Giancarlo Giannini and Catherine Deneuve.

the lady of the camellias.title: The Lady of the Camellias
the lady of the camellias.wikipedia: The Lady of the Camellias (1981 film)
the lady of the camellias.description: The Lady of the Camellias (French: La Dame aux camélias, Italian: La storia vera della signora dalle camelie) is a 1981 French-Italian drama film directed by Mauro Bolognini and starring Isabelle Huppert.

judgement.title: Judgement
judgement.description: Judgement (Korean: 심판) is a 1999 short film by South Korean director Park Chan-wook based on the 1995 Sampoong Department Store collapse.

night fishing.title: Night Fishing
night fishing.description: Night Fishing (Korean: 파란만장; lit." or "A Checkered Past") is a 2011 South Korean fantasy-horror short film directed, produced, written by PARKing CHANce, brand name of the brothers, Park Chan-wook and Park Chan-kyong.

avatar the way of water.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
avatar the way of water.description: Avatar: The Way of Water is a 2022 American epic science fiction film directed by James Cameron and written by Cameron, Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver. It is the second installment in the Avatar film series and the sequel to Avatar (2009).

ediths tagebuch.title: Ediths Tagebuch
ediths tagebuch.description: Edith's Diary (German: Ediths Tagebuch) is a 1983 West German thriller-drama film written and directed by Hans W. Geißendörfer. It was entered into the main competition at the 40th edition of the Venice Film Festival.

the attorney.title: The Attorney
the attorney.description: The Attorney (Korean: 변호인; RR: Byeonhoin) is a 2013 South Korean legal drama film directed and co-written by Yang Woo-suk in his directorial debut.9 billion, The Attorney became the 15th-best-selling Korean film of all time and the second-highest-grossing Korean film of 2013.

happy end.title: Happy End
happy end.description: Happy End is a 2017 drama film written and directed by Michael Haneke, and starring Isabelle Huppert and Jean-Louis Trintignant, who had also played daughter and father in Haneke's 2012 film Amour. The film was selected to compete for the Palme d'Or in the main competition section at the 2017 Cannes Film Festival.

sheer madness.title: Sheer Madness
sheer madness.description: Sheer Madness (German: Heller Wahn, and also released as Friends and Husbands) is a 1983 German arthouse drama film directed by Margarethe von Trotta. It was entered into the 33rd Berlin International Film Festival.

husband and wife.title: Husband and Wife
husband and wife.description: Husband and Wife (Japanese: 夫婦, Hepburn: Fūfu) is a 1953 Japanese comedy-drama film directed by Mikio Naruse.

wife.title: Wife
wife.description: Wife (Japanese: 妻, romanized: Tsuma) is a 1953 Japanese drama film directed by Mikio Naruse. It is based on Fumiko Hayashi's novel Chairo no me (1950).

rapture.title: Rapture
rapture.description: Rapture (French: La fleur de l'âge) is a 1965 drama film directed by John Guillermin, and starring Melvyn Douglas, Patricia Gozzi, and Dean Stockwell. It was written by Stanley Mann based on the 1954 novel Rapture in My Rags by Phyliss Hastings.

goopy bagha phire elo.title: Goopy Bagha Phire Elo
goopy bagha phire elo.description: Goopy Bagha Phirey Elo (lit. 'Goopy and Bagha have returned') is a 1992 Indian Bengali comedy film directed by Sandip Ray and written by Satyajit Ray. A sequel to the 1980 film Hirak Rajar Deshe and the third installment of Goopy Gyne Bagha Byne series, the film was released twelve years after its predecessor.

lola montes.title: Lola Montès
lola montes.description: Lola Montès is a 1955 historical romance film, and the last completed film of director Max Ophüls.

someone s watching me.title: Someone's Watching Me!
someone s watching me.description: Someone's Watching Me! is a 1978 American made-for-television thriller film written and directed by John Carpenter and starring Lauren Hutton, David Birney and Adrienne Barbeau. The film was made immediately prior to Carpenter's theatrical hit Halloween; it was produced by Warner Bros.

in public.title: In Public
in public.description: In Public (simplified Chinese: 公共场所; traditional Chinese: 公共場所; pinyin: Gōng gōng cháng sǔo; lit. 'Public space') is a short documentary film directed by Jia Zhangke, a Chinese cinema "Sixth Generation" movement filmmaker.

the empty table.title: The Empty Table
the empty table.description: The Empty Table (Japanese: 食卓のない家, romanized: Shokutaku no nai ie), also known as Family Without a Dinner Table, is a 1985 Japanese drama film co-written and directed by Masaki Kobayashi, at his final film.

tale of tales.title: Tale of Tales
tale of tales.description: Tale of Tales is a 2015 fantasy horror film co-written, directed and co-produced by Matteo Garrone and starring Salma Hayek, Vincent Cassel, Toby Jones, and John C. Reilly. It is based on a collection of fairy tales by Italian poet Giambattista Basile, titled Pentamerone.

joe s apartment.title: Joe's Apartment
joe s apartment.description: Joe's Apartment is a 1996 American musical black comedy film written and directed by John Payson (in his feature directorial debut), based on his 1992 short film of the same name, and starring Jerry O'Connell and Megan Ward.

stalag 17.title: Stalag 17
stalag 17.description: Stalag 17 is a 1953 American war film that recounts the story of a group of American airmen confined in a German prisoner-of-war camp. The film focuses on one particular barracks, where the men come to suspect that one of their number is an informant.

the alamo.title: The Alamo
the alamo.description: The Alamo is a 2004 American historical war film about the Battle of the Alamo during the Texas Revolution. It is directed by John Lee Hancock and stars Dennis Quaid as Sam Houston, Billy Bob Thornton as Davy Crockett, Jason Patric as Jim Bowie, Patrick Wilson as William B.

grand slam.title: Grand Slam
grand slam.description: Grand Slam (Italian: Ad ogni costo, lit. 'At any cost') is a 1967 heist film directed by Giuliano Montaldo and starring Janet Leigh, Robert Hoffmann, Klaus Kinski, Riccardo Cucciolla, George Rigaud, Adolfo Celi and Edward G.

my dear killer.title: My Dear Killer
my dear killer.description: My Dear Killer (Italian: Mio caro assassino) is a 1972 Italian-Spanish giallo film directed by Tonino Valerii and starring George Hilton, Marilù Tolo, Patty Shepard, Helga Line, Salvo Randone and William Berger.

libera my love.title: Libera, My Love
libera my love.description: ) is a 1975 Italian drama film directed by Mauro Bolognini and starring Claudia Cardinale. Running from about 1905 to 1945, it features a fiery Italian woman who rejects Catholicism, fascism, communism and even liberal democracy to live and die a committed anarchist.

si salvi chi vuole.title: Si salvi chi vuole
si salvi chi vuole.description: Si salvi chi vuole is a 1980 Italian film. It stars Claudia Cardinale.

control.title: Control
control.description: Il giorno prima (internationally released as Control and Mind Control) is a 1987 Italian thriller film directed by Giuliano Montaldo and starring Burt Lancaster and Ben Gazzara. The story was written by Piero Angela and the screenplay was by Piero Angela, Jeremy Hole, Giuliano Montaldo and Brian Moore.

regarding henry.title: Regarding Henry
regarding henry.description: J. Abrams. It stars Harrison Ford as a New York City lawyer from a dysfunctional family, who struggles to regain his memory and recover his speech and mobility after he survives a shooting, inadvertently restoring his family's integrity in the process.

the wolves.title: The Wolves
the wolves.description: The Wolves (Italian: Uomini e lupi) is a 1956 Italian neorealistic drama film directed by Giuseppe De Santis.

castle keep.title: Castle Keep
castle keep.description: Castle Keep is a 1969 American war comedy-drama film combining surrealism with tragic realism. It was directed by Sydney Pollack, and starred Burt Lancaster, Patrick O'Neal, Jean-Pierre Aumont, Bruce Dern and Peter Falk.

il marchese del grillo.title: Il Marchese del Grillo
il marchese del grillo.description: Il Marchese del Grillo (The Marquess del Grillo, internationally released as The Marquis of Grillo) is a 1981 Italian comedic motion picture directed by Mario Monicelli, starring Alberto Sordi as the title character.

tenebrae.title: Tenebrae
tenebrae.description: Tenebrae (lit. '"darkness"', also known as Tenebre) is a 1982 Italian giallo film, written and directed by Dario Argento.

danton.title: Danton
danton.description: Danton (French pronunciation: [dɑ̃tɔ̃]) is a 1983 French-language film depicting the last weeks of Georges Danton, one of the leaders of the French Revolution. It is an adaptation of the 1929 play The Danton Case by Stanisława Przybyszewska.

the last mimzy.title: The Last Mimzy
the last mimzy.description: The Last Mimzy is a 2007 American science fiction adventure drama film directed by New Line Cinema founder Robert Shaye. It was loosely based upon the 1943 science fiction short story "Mimsy Were the Borogoves" by Lewis Padgett (a pseudonym of husband-and-wife team Henry Kuttner and C.

halbblut.title: Halbblut
halbblut.description: Halbblut (lit. 'Half-blood' or 'Halfbreed') is a 1919 German silent film directed by Fritz Lang.

help me.title: Help Me
help me.description: Help Me, My Love (Italian: Amore mio aiutami) is a 1969 commedia all'italiana film co-written and directed by Alberto Sordi, who stars alongside Monica Vitti. The film follows a happily married couple whose relationship is thrown into turmoil when the wife falls in love with another man.

widows.title: Widows
widows.description: Widows is a 2018 neo-noir heist thriller film directed by Steve McQueen from a screenplay by Gillian Flynn and McQueen, based upon the 1983 British television series of the same name.

burn.title: Burn!
burn.description: Burn! (original title: Queimada, Portuguese for "Burnt" or "Burned") is a 1969 historical war drama film directed by Gillo Pontecorvo.

city hall.title: City Hall
city hall.description: City Hall is a 1996 American political thriller film directed by Harold Becker and starring Al Pacino, John Cusack, Bridget Fonda and Danny Aiello. The film is Becker's second collaboration with Pacino, having directed him in Sea of Love (1989).

the fighting pimpernel.title: The Fighting Pimpernel
the fighting pimpernel.description: The Elusive Pimpernel is a 1950 British period adventure film by the British-based director-writer team of Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger, based on the novel The Scarlet Pimpernel (1905) by Baroness Emmuska Orczy.

dementia 13.title: Dementia 13
dementia 13.description: Dementia 13 (released in the United Kingdom as The Haunted and the Hunted) is a 1963 horror thriller film written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola in his feature film directorial debut, and starring William Campbell, Luana Anders, Bart Patton, Mary Mitchel, Eithne Dunne, and Patrick Magee.

you re a big boy now.title: You're a Big Boy Now
you re a big boy now.description: You're a Big Boy Now is a 1966 American comedy film written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola. Based on David Benedictus' 1963 novel of the same name, it stars Elizabeth Hartman, Peter Kastner, Geraldine Page, her spouse Rip Torn, Karen Black, Tony Bill, Michael Dunn, and Julie Harris.

visions of eight.title: Visions of Eight
visions of eight.description: Visions of Eight is a 1973 American documentary film offering a stylized look at the 1972 Summer Olympics. Produced by Stan Margulies and executive produced by David L. Wolper, it was directed by eight directors.

distant vision.title: Distant Vision
distant vision.description: Distant Vision is an ongoing experimental film project by Francis Ford Coppola. Different versions of this production have been broadcast to limited audiences from the stages of Oklahoma City Community College on June 5, 2015, and at UCLA School of Theater in July 2016.

the 317th platoon.title: The 317th Platoon
the 317th platoon.description: The 317th Platoon (French: La 317ème section) is a 1965 French black-and-white war film set during the First Indochina War (1946–54) written and directed by Pierre Schoendoerffer. The film was based on Schoendoerffer's 1963 novel of the same name.

the jerusalem file.title: The Jerusalem File
the jerusalem file.description: The Jerusalem File (also known as Jerusalem, Jerusalem) is a 1972 American film directed by John Flynn and starring Bruce Davison, Nicol Williamson, Daria Halprin, and Donald Pleasence. It was written by Troy Kennedy Martin.

the reader.title: The Reader
the reader.description: The Reader is a 2008 romantic drama film directed by Stephen Daldry, scripted by David Hare, adapting the 1995 German novel Der Vorleser by Bernhard Schlink, and starring Kate Winslet, Ralph Fiennes, David Kross, Bruno Ganz, and Karoline Herfurth.

out 1.title: Out 1
out 1.description: Out 1, also referred to as Out 1: Noli Me Tangere, is a 1971 French experimental mystery film written and directed by Jacques Rivette and Suzanne Schiffman. It is indebted to Honoré de Balzac's La Comédie humaine, particularly the History of the Thirteen collection (1833–35).

young husbands.title: Young Husbands
young husbands.description: Young Husbands (Italian: Giovani mariti) is a 1958 Italian comedy film directed by Mauro Bolognini. It was entered into the 1958 Cannes Film Festival. For this film Armando Nannuzzi won a Silver Ribbon (Nastro d'Argento) for Best Cinematography.

count tacchia.title: Count Tacchia
count tacchia.description: Il conte Tacchia, internationally released as Count Tacchia, is a 1982 Italian comedy film directed by Sergio Corbucci. The main character of the film is inspired by the real count Tacchia, Adriano Bennicelli.

abc africa.title: ABC Africa
abc africa.description: ABC Africa (Persian: ای‌بی‌سی آفریقا) is a 2001 Iranian documentary feature film directed by Abbas Kiarostami. It was screened out of competition at the 2001 Cannes Film Festival.

mr arkadin.title: Mr. Arkadin
mr arkadin.description: Mr. Arkadin (also released as Confidential Report) is a 1955 thriller film noir written, produced and directed by Orson Welles. It stars Welles, Robert Arden, Paola Mori, Michael Redgrave, Patricia Medina, Akim Tamiroff, Peter van Eyck, and Katina Paxinou.

unholy desire.title: Unholy Desire
unholy desire.description: a. Intentions of Murder (赤い殺意, Akai Satsui; lit. "Red Murderous Intent") is a 1964 Japanese drama film by director Shōhei Imamura.

the pied piper.title: The Pied Piper
the pied piper.description: The Pied Piper (also known as Le Joueur de flûte) is a 1972 British musical fantasy film directed by Jacques Demy and starring Jack Wild, Donald Pleasence, John Hurt and Diana Dors, and featuring Donovan, who also composed music for the film.

giordano bruno.title: Giordano Bruno
giordano bruno.description: Giordano Bruno is a 1973 Italian biographical drama film directed by Giuliano Montaldo. It was produced by Carlo Ponti.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: Legend is a 1985 American epic dark fantasy adventure film directed by Ridley Scott, written by William Hjortsberg, and starring Tom Cruise, Mia Sara, Tim Curry, David Bennent, Alice Playten, Billy Barty, Cork Hubbert and Annabelle Lanyon.

jack.title: Jack
jack.description: Jack is a 1996 American coming-of-age comedy-drama film co-produced and directed by Francis Ford Coppola. The film stars Robin Williams, Diane Lane, Jennifer Lopez, Brian Kerwin, Fran Drescher, and Bill Cosby.

holy smoke.title: Holy Smoke!
holy smoke.description: Holy Smoke! is a 1999 independent romantic comedy drama film directed by Jane Campion, and starring Kate Winslet and Harvey Keitel. The plot follows an American exit counselor (Keitel) who attempts to deprogram a young Australian woman (Winslet) who has been indoctrinated into a new age cult in India.

a slice of life.title: A Slice of Life
a slice of life.description: A Slice of Life (Italian: Tempi nostri, French: Quelques pas dans la vie, also known as The Anatomy of Love) is a 1954 Italian comedy film directed by Alessandro Blasetti and Paul Paviot.

gidget goes to rome.title: Gidget Goes to Rome
gidget goes to rome.description: Gidget Goes to Rome is a 1963 American romantic comedy film produced by Columbia Pictures in Eastmancolor starring Cindy Carol as the archetypal high school teen surfer girl originally portrayed by Sandra Dee in the 1959 film Gidget.

conrack.title: Conrack
conrack.description: Conrack is a 1974 American drama film based on the 1972 autobiographical book The Water Is Wide by Pat Conroy, directed by Martin Ritt and starring Jon Voight in the title role, alongside Paul Winfield, Madge Sinclair, Hume Cronyn and Antonio Fargas.

it could happen to you.title: It Could Happen to You
it could happen to you.wikipedia: It Could Happen to You (1994 film)
it could happen to you.description: It Could Happen to You is a 1994 American romantic comedy-drama film starring Nicolas Cage and Bridget Fonda. In a plot inspired by a real-life news story, a New York Police Department officer (Cage) who is short on cash and unable to tip his waitress (Fonda), half-jokingly offers to share his winnings if he happens to win the lottery.

the general s daughter.title: The General's Daughter
the general s daughter.description: The General's Daughter is a 1999 American mystery thriller film directed by Simon West and written by Christopher Bertolini and William Goldman, based on the 1992 novel by Nelson DeMille. It stars John Travolta and Madeleine Stowe, with James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, Clarence Williams III, and James Woods in supporting roles.

when women lost their tails.title: When Women Lost Their Tails
when women lost their tails.description: When Women Lost Their Tails (Italian: Quando le donne persero la coda) is a 1972 Italian fantasy-comedy film directed by Pasquale Festa Campanile. It is the sequel of When Women Had Tails.

the little house.title: The Little House
the little house.description: The Little House (小さいおうち, Chiisai Ouchi) is a 2014 Japanese drama film directed by Yoji Yamada and based on a novel by Kyoko Nakajima. It was released in Japan on 25 January 2014.

star wars episode viii the last jedi.title: Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi
star wars episode viii the last jedi.description: Star Wars: The Last Jedi, also known as Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi, or simply The Last Jedi, is a 2017 American epic space opera film written and directed by Rian Johnson.

task force.title: Task Force
task force.description: S. aircraft carriers from USS Langley (CV-1) to USS Franklin (CV-13). Although Robert Montgomery was originally considered for the leading role, the film stars Gary Cooper, Jane Wyatt, Walter Brennan, Wayne Morris, Julie London and Jack Holt.

come fill the cup.title: Come Fill the Cup
come fill the cup.description: Come Fill the Cup is a 1951 film starring James Cagney and Gig Young, directed by Gordon Douglas. Young's performance was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. Cagney plays an alcoholic newspaperman.

close to my heart.title: Close to My Heart
close to my heart.description: Close to My Heart is a 1951 American drama film directed by William Keighley, written by James R. Webb (based on his novel A Baby for Midge) and starring Ray Milland and Gene Tierney.

o henry s full house.title: O. Henry's Full House
o henry s full house.description: O. Henry's Full House is a 1952 American anthology film made by 20th Century Fox, consisting of five films, each based on a story by O. Henry. The film was produced by André Hakim and directed by five directors from five screenplays with different authors.

mara maru.title: Mara Maru
mara maru.description: Mara Maru is a 1952 American action film noir directed by Gordon Douglas and starring Errol Flynn, Ruth Roman and Raymond Burr. It is Flynn's final film for Warner Bros. Pictures, the studio where he started in Hollywood in 1935.

room for one more.title: Room for One More
room for one more.description: Room for One More is a 1952 American family comedy-drama film directed by Norman Taurog, produced by Henry Blanke, and starring Cary Grant and Betsy Drake. The screenplay, written by Jack Rose and Melville Shavelson, was based on the 1950 autobiography of the same name by Anna Perrott Rose.

the moon is the sun s dream.title: The Moon Is... the Sun's Dream
the moon is the sun s dream.wikipedia: The Moon Is... the Sun's Dream
the moon is the sun s dream.description: The Moon Is... the Sun's Dream (Korean: 달은... 해가 꾸는 꿈) is a 1992 South Korean film directed by Park Chan-wook in his feature directorial debut. A crime drama involving a love triangle between a singer, a gangster, and the gangster's photographer brother, it features pop star Lee Seung-chul in his acting debut.

memento.title: Memento
memento.description: Memento is a 2000 American neo-noir psychological thriller film written for the screen and directed by Christopher Nolan, based on the 2001 short story "Memento Mori" by his brother, Jonathan Nolan. The film stars Guy Pearce, Carrie-Anne Moss, and Joe Pantoliano.

perhaps love.title: Perhaps Love
perhaps love.description: Perhaps Love is a 2005 Hong Kong musical film directed by Peter Chan, written by Lam Oi-wah and Raymond To, choreographed by Farah Khan and starring Zhou Xun, Takeshi Kaneshiro and Jacky Cheung. It was funded by Astro Shaw and TVB, and was distributed by Celestial Pictures.

in time.title: In Time
in time.description: In Time is a 2011 American science fiction action film written, co-produced, and directed by Andrew Niccol.

bugonia.title: Bugonia
bugonia.description: Bugonia is a 2025 dark comedy film directed by Yorgos Lanthimos and written by Will Tracy. An English-language remake of the 2003 South Korean film Save the Green Planet! by Jang Joon-hwan, the film follows two young men who kidnap a powerful CEO, suspecting that she is secretly an alien who wants to destroy Earth.

weekend at dunkirk.title: Weekend at Dunkirk
weekend at dunkirk.description: Weekend at Dunkirk (French: Week-end à Zuydcoote) is a 1964 French-Italian drama war film directed by Henri Verneuil and starring Jean-Paul Belmondo. It is based on the 1949 Prix Goncourt winning novel Week-end at Zuydcoote (French: Week-end à Zuydcoote) by Robert Merle.

damien omen ii.title: Damien: Omen II
damien omen ii.description: Damien – Omen II is a 1978 supernatural horror film directed by Don Taylor. It is the sequel to The Omen, and the second installment of The Omen series. It stars William Holden and Lee Grant, with Jonathan Scott-Taylor, Robert Foxworth, Lew Ayres, Sylvia Sidney, Lance Henriksen, Ian Hendry, and Leo McKern.

the power of emotion.title: The Power of Emotion
the power of emotion.description: The Power of Emotion (German: Die Macht der Gefühle) is a 1983 West German essay film written and directed by Alexander Kluge. It was entered into the main competition at the 40th Venice International Film Festival.

hymn to a tired man.title: Hymn to a Tired Man
hymn to a tired man.description: Hymn to a Tired Man (Japanese: 日本の青春, Hepburn: Nihon no Seishun; lit. 'Youth of Japan') is a 1968 Japanese drama film directed by Masaki Kobayashi.

fur.title: Fur
fur.description: Fur: An Imaginary Portrait of Diane Arbus (also known simply as Fur) is a 2006 American romantic drama film directed by Steven Shainberg and written by Erin Cressida Wilson, based on Patricia Bosworth's book Diane Arbus: A Biography.

where the wild things are.title: Where the Wild Things Are
where the wild things are.description: Where the Wild Things Are is a 2009 American fantasy adventure film directed by Spike Jonze, who co-wrote the screenplay with Dave Eggers. Based on Maurice Sendak's 1963 children's book, it combines live-action, performers in costumes, animatronics, and computer-generated imagery (CGI).

the hoax.title: The Hoax
the hoax.description: The Hoax is a 2006 American comedy-drama film starring Richard Gere, directed by Swedish filmmaker Lasse Hallström. The screenplay by William Wheeler is based on the book of the same title by Clifford Irving.

tom sawyer.title: Tom Sawyer
tom sawyer.description: Tom Sawyer is a 1973 American musical film adaptation of the Mark Twain novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer directed by Don Taylor. The film was produced by Reader's Digest in collaboration with Arthur P. Jacobs, and its screenplay and songs were written by the Sherman Brothers, Robert B.

jaws 2.title: Jaws 2
jaws 2.description: Jaws 2 is a 1978 American thriller film directed by Jeannot Szwarc and written by Howard Sackler and Carl Gottlieb. It is the sequel to Steven Spielberg's Jaws (1975), and the second installment in the Jaws franchise.

heartbeeps.title: Heartbeeps
heartbeeps.description: Heartbeeps is a 1981 American science fiction romantic comedy film about two robots who fall in love and decide to strike out on their own.

a chinese tall story.title: A Chinese Tall Story
a chinese tall story.description: A Chinese Tall Story (Chinese: 情癲大聖; Cantonese Yale: Ching din dai sing) is a 2005 Hong Kong fantasy adventure film written and directed by Jeffrey Lau. The story is loosely based on the 16th-century novel Journey to the West.

thrilling.title: Thrilling
thrilling.description: Thrilling is a 1965 Italian comedy film. The film is split into three distinct segments, each directed by a different director; namely Carlo Lizzani, Ettore Scola and Gian Luigi Polidoro.

wake up and die.title: Wake Up and Die
wake up and die.description: Wake Up and Die (Italian: Svegliati e uccidi, French: Lutring... réveille-toi et meurs), also known as Wake Up and Kill and I Kill for Kicks, is a 1966 Italian-French crime-drama film directed by Carlo Lizzani, based on real life events of Luciano Lutring, an Italian criminal known as "the machine-gun soloist" ("il solista del mitra").

chronicle of a homicide.title: Chronicle of a Homicide
chronicle of a homicide.description: Chronicle of a Homicide (Italian: Imputazione di omicidio per uno studente, lit. 'Homicide charge against a student') is a 1972 Italian crime-drama film directed by Mauro Bolognini.

copkiller.title: Copkiller
copkiller.description: Copkiller (Italian: Copkiller (L'assassino dei poliziotti)), also released as Corrupt, Corrupt Lieutenant, and The Order of Death, is a 1983 Italian crime thriller film directed by Roberto Faenza and starring Harvey Keitel and John Lydon, the lead singer for the bands Sex Pistols and Public Image Ltd.

single white female.title: Single White Female
single white female.description: Single White Female is a 1992 American psychological erotic thriller film produced and directed by Barbet Schroeder from a screenplay by Don Roos. It is based on the 1990 novel SWF Seeks Same by John Lutz.

according to pereira.title: According to Pereira
according to pereira.description: According to Pereira (Italian: Sostiene Pereira, French: Pereira prétend, Afirma Pereira in Portugal and Páginas da revolução in Brazil) is a 1995 Italian drama film directed by Roberto Faenza. It is based on Antonio Tabucchi's novel Sostiene Pereira.

the tales of hoffmann.title: The Tales of Hoffmann
the tales of hoffmann.description: The Tales of Hoffmann is a 1951 British Technicolor comic opera film written, produced and directed by the team of Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger working under the umbrella of their production company The Archers.

cops and robbers.title: Cops and Robbers
cops and robbers.description: Cops and Robbers (Italian: Guardie e ladri) is a 1951 Italian cult comedy film directed by Steno and Mario Monicelli. It stars the famous comedian Totò, and the cinematographer was the future film director Mario Bava.

robinson crusoe.title: Robinson Crusoe
robinson crusoe.description: Robinson Crusoe (Spanish: Aventuras de Robinson Crusoe; also released as Adventures of Robinson Crusoe) is a 1954 adventure film directed by Luis Buñuel, based on the 1719 novel of the same name by Daniel Defoe.

the big mess.title: The Big Mess
the big mess.description: The Big Mess (German: Der große Verhau) is a 1971 West German sci-fi drama film written and directed by Alexander Kluge. It premiered at the 21st edition of the Berlin International Film Festival, in the Forum sidebar.

in the valley of elah.title: In the Valley of Elah
in the valley of elah.description: In the Valley of Elah is a 2007 American crime drama film written and directed by Paul Haggis. The film stars Tommy Lee Jones, Charlize Theron, and Susan Sarandon. Its title refers to the Biblical valley where the battle between David and Goliath took place.

revolutionary road.title: Revolutionary Road
revolutionary road.description: Revolutionary Road is a 2008 romantic drama film directed by Sam Mendes and written by Justin Haythe, based on the 1961 novel by Richard Yates.
